source.title: Copy of N5E 2025 Adversary Builder (Make a copy)

traits.name: Abandon a Friend
traits.description: When an allied creature falls to 0 hit points or dies, as a reaction, you can dash away from combat, with a +30ft movement speed for this reaction only.

traits.name: Above All
traits.description: Gain a Flying speed equal to walking speed. Always hover 5 feet off the ground.

traits.name: Adapting Defenses
traits.description: When you take damage of any type, after the damage is calculated and applied, you gain resistance to that damage type until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Adept Elementalist
traits.description: Select one damage type. Increase damage done with the chosen damage type by +1 damage die and gain resistance to the chosen damage type.

traits.name: Adept Sensory Shinobi
traits.description: If a creature has Chakra and is within 10 miles of you, you can sense them and know their general location.

traits.name: Adhesive
traits.description: You can adhere to anything you touch. As an action you can choose to automatically grapple any object or creature within your unarmed attack range. Creatures grappled in this way, make their contested checks to escape at disadvantage.

traits.name: Advanced Study
traits.description: You know jutsu up to 1 rank higher than your current limitations.

traits.name: Aggresive
traits.description: When an allied creature is adjacent to a hostile creature you are adjacent to, gain a 1d4 bonus to damage rolls.

traits.name: Agile Wits
traits.description: Select one between Dexterity or Intelligence. The chosen ability score gains a bonus 1d4 to its saving throws and ability checks.

traits.name: Alarm
traits.description: When you would you take damage, all other adveraries of the within 100ft are aware of your pain.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: You can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. Additionally, when you would attempt to escape the restrained or grappled conditions, you makes your check or save at advantage.

traits.name: Aura: Damaging
traits.description: Creatures that begin their turns within 10 feet of you take damage equal to your level.

traits.name: Aura: Destabalized Chakra Field
traits.description: All hostile creatures within 10 feet, who is attempting to cast a Jutsu of C-Rank or lower, must make an ability check using their casting modifier vs DC (8+Your level). On a failure, the jutsu fails to cast. Their chakra is still spent.

traits.name: Aura: FrighteningAura
traits.description: All hostile creatures within 10 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw. On a failed save, they gain 1 Rank of Fear while inside this aura, or for one minute. A feared creature remakes this saving throw at the end of each of their turns.

traits.name: Backstab
traits.description: If you have advantage on your attack, add your level in extra damage to the triggering attack.

traits.name: Barbed Hide
traits.description: At the start of your turns, deal your level in piercing, bludgeoning or Slashing damage to any creature that you are currently grappling.

traits.name: Believe it!
traits.description: Once per encounter, gain advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Bestowed Strength
traits.description: This adversary has been given the power of another, Stronger, adversary who is Iconic, Elite or Solo. Gain one trait, that adversary has, regardless of what it is.
traits.categories: Attack, Defence, Control, Mobility, Utility, Buff

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.description: +1d4 to melee attack rolls against any creature that has 50% or less hit points.

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.description: When a hostile creature scores a critical hit against this adversary, this adversary can immediately make a weapon attack against the triggering creature. On a hit,it automatically score a critical hit against the triggering creature.

traits.name: Brutal Brawler
traits.description: All Melee weapon attacks gain +1 bonus damage die.

traits.name: Can't hold me down
traits.description: Advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to end the Restrained, Grappled or Prone conditions.

traits.name: Chakra Efficiency
traits.description: Jutsu cost is reduced to the previous Ranks Cost.  (S-Rank: 20, A-Rank: 14, B-Rank: 9, C-Rank: 5, D-Rank: 2)

traits.name: Chakra Weapons
traits.description: Your weapons are counted as Chakra enhanced and they gain a bonus to hit and damage equal to 1/6th of your level.

traits.name: Charger
traits.description: If you moved more than half your maximum movement in a straight line towards your target, make your melee attack roll with advantage. On a hit, you knock your target prone in addition to any other effect.

traits.name: Clone Adept
traits.description: Clones summoned gain access to all General Traits you have.

traits.name: Clone Defense
traits.description: When an allied creature would take damage while within 20 feet of a clone, as a reaction, swap places with the original target and the clone.

traits.name: Clone Expert
traits.description: Clones summoned gain access to all Clan traits you have.

traits.name: Clone master
traits.description: Clones summoned gain access to all Role traits you have.

traits.name: Combat Medic
traits.description: Twice per combat, when you would deal damage with a jutsu with the medical keyword, you can choose to deal maximum damage.

traits.name: Combat Seal Weaving
traits.description: When a hostile creature makes a saving throw vs a Jutsu you cast, if they fail the check and the difference between their roll and your Save DC is 10 or greater, add level to damage.

traits.name: Corrosive Body
traits.description: Each time a creature touches or deals damage as the result of a melee attack to you, it takes 2d6 Acid damage. Additionally, any weapon used to strike you suffers a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. The weapon is destroyed if the penalty ever reaches −5. Casting Mending would remove all penalty stacks.

traits.name: Critical Fury
traits.description: All attacks made by you have a +1 bonus to its critical threat range.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.description: Dash, disengage, or hide as a bonus action.

traits.name: Damage Absorption
traits.description: Select one damage type, you gain immunity to the chosen damage type, and gain a number of hit points equal to the damage originally dealt. If a creature would ignore resistance or immunity to the chosen damage type, this features effects become null against the creature or its attacks/jutsu.

traits.name: Damage Transfer
traits.description: Allied creatures within 15ft that take damage, has the damage they would take reduced by half, and you take damage equal to the damage originally reduced. The damage done is of the same type the allied creature originally took. Additionally, if you and the allied creatures would take damage as the result of the same area of effect, all creatures within 15ft including you, takes half damage from the area of effect.

traits.name: Dangerous Body
traits.description: Each time a creature touches or deals you damage as the result of a melee attack all creatures within 5 feet of you take 3d6 Necrotic damage, as your body releases a dangerous aura.

traits.name: Dirty Tricks
traits.description: When a creature within 15ft of you makes a melee attack, as a reaction, force the target to make a Wisdom (Perception) check vs your Dexterity (Sleight of Hand). If you beat their check, you throw dirt in their eyes blinding them until the end of their next turn. Alternatively, they can spend a bonus action wiping the dirt from their eyes, immediately ending the blinded condition.

traits.name: Dragon Fist
traits.description: Can mark creature as Reaction. Marked creature remains marked for 1 minute or until another creature is marked. A marked creature suffers a 1d4 penalty to its AC when you would target them with unarmed attacks until the end of the current turn.

traits.name: Drunken Fist
traits.description: When you are targeted for an attack, you can take the dodge action as a reaction, and move 10 feet not provoking Attacks of opportunity.

traits.name: Durable
traits.description: Hit Points increased by 30%. (Manual update U12 with this multiplier)

traits.name: Eight Inner Gates (1)
traits.description: 1 ACTION: Activate the eight inner gates (1). Increase Strength, Dexterity and Constitution Modifier by +1. (Can end as Bonus action or when unconscious.)

traits.name: Eight Inner Gates (2)
traits.description:
*Must have Eight Inner Gates (1) active. 
As a bonus action, activate your eight inner gates (2), ending Inner gates (1). Gain a +5 bonus points to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution, double speed, and gain an additional Action. At the start of each of the adversaries turns (including Elite Actions),  take 1d12 necrotic damage which cannot be resisted or reduced by any means. (This can be ended as a bonus action on the users turn or when they fall unconcious.)

traits.name: Eight Inner Gates (3)
traits.description:
*Must have Eight Inner Gates (2) active.
As an Action, activate your eight inner gates (3), ending Inner gates (2).Gain +10 bonus points to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution, triple movement speed, and an additional two actions. At the start of each of the adversaries turns (including Elite and Legendary Actions), take 3d12 necrotic damage which cannot be resisted or reduced by any means. (This cannot be ended.)

traits.name: Elemental Protection
traits.description: Select two damage types. Gain Resistance to the select damage types. Select one damage type. Gain vulnerability to the chosen damage type.

traits.name: Endurance
traits.description: Chakra Points increased by 30%

traits.name: Enhanced Nature Release
traits.description: Pick 1 nature release. Increase the damage die of the chosen nature release by 1/6th of your level.

traits.name: Escape
traits.description: When you would be reduced to 0 hit points outside of your lair, you instead escape and flee to your lair. You remain there, paralysed and resting, until you recover at least 50% of your hit points.

traits.name: Evasive
traits.description: When subjected to a Dexterity Saving throw. If you would pass, you instead take no damage and suffer no effects.

traits.name: Expert Elementalist
traits.description: Select one elemental damage type. Increase damage done with the chosen damage type by +2 damage die and gain immunity to the chosen damage type. You gain vulnerability to the nature releases superior element.

traits.name: Expert Seal Weaver
traits.description: Twice per combat, you can cast one Ninjutsu or Genjutsu with a casting time of 1 Action, as a bonus action.
traits.categories: Attack, Defence, Control, Mobility, Utility, Buff

traits.name: Expert Sensory Shinobi
traits.description: If a creature has Chakra and is within 100 miles of you, you can sense them and know their general location.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: Bonus + 5 to Deception, Performance and Persuasion. (Automatically Added)

traits.name: Flight
traits.description: You can fly your speed. While flying, you must move your entire movement speed or land—unless you can also hover. Launching into flight provokes opportunity attacks, even if you Disengage.

traits.name: Force of Will
traits.description: When subjected to a Wisdom saving throw. If you would pass, you instead take no damage and suffer no effects

traits.name: Fortuitous
traits.description: When subjected to a Constitution saving throw. If you would pass, you instead take no damage and suffer no effects

traits.name: Freedom of Movement
traits.description: Immunity to difficult terrain and speed reduction effects.

traits.name: Grappler
traits.description: Advantage on attack rolls against any target currently grappled. In addition, while grappling a target, any damage you take from an attack or jutsu is split 50/50 evenly with the grappled creature.

traits.name: Great Weapon Master
traits.description: While wielding a weapon with two hands, this Adversary can choose to take a -5 penalty to its attack roll, gaining a +10 bonus to damage rolls, once per turn.

traits.name: Grimy
traits.description: When you hit a creature with a melee or ranged weapon attack, you may spend your bonus action to disarm them immediately taking their weapon away from them, if they had one equiped, or if they have on visable on their person.

traits.name: Guerilla
traits.description: When you make an ranged attack while hidden, you don't reveal yourself and can remain in hiding so long as you do not move more than half your full movement and remain obscured in some way.

traits.name: Healer
traits.description: When you would heal a creature, you double the die used to restore hit points.

traits.name: Heavy Weapon Expert
traits.description: While wielding a weapon with the heavy weapon property, add 2d4 to all damage rolls made with the weapon. (Already Added)

traits.name: Honorable
traits.description: When initiative it rolled, mark 1 hostile creature. A creature marked in this way, remains marked for the duration of this encounter or until killed. An unconscious creature loses any marks. Only one creature can be marked at a time. While a creature is marked, add 1d4 to attack and damage rolls against the marked creature and suffer a 1d6 penalty to attack and damage rolls against creatures who are not marked.

traits.name: Immortal
traits.description: You cannot be killed unless you are reduced to 0 hit points by a specific damage type, or type of attack. Any other form of attack or damage will reduce you to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: You are immune to any Jutsu or effect that would alter your form.

traits.name: Improved Critical
traits.description: Critical hits increase their damage die by a 1/6th of your level.

traits.name: Incorporeal
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can become incorporeal. While incorporeal you can pass through any solid non-chakra based matter and cannot be harmed by Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu. This includes Class mod Arts that would require physical interaction by any means. A creature can only remain incorporeal until the beginning of their next turn.

traits.name: Indominable
traits.description: You are immune to any effects that would alter your mind or will. This includes Charmed and Fear. You cannot be mind controlled or be influeneced by external forces.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.description: You are immune to any effect that would sense your emotions, read your thoughts or sense your intentions.

traits.name: Inspiring Leader
traits.description: As an action you can command your allies in initiative bolstering their resolve. All allies gain your level + your proficiency bonus temporary hit points for the next minute. Recharge (5-6)

traits.name: Invisible
traits.description: You cannot be seen by normal means. You can only be seen or sensed as a result of a Sensory Jutsu or special sight such as Chakra sight or True Sight. A creature who would attempt to cast Uzumaki Break or Dispel Chakra against you temporarily disables this trait for 1d4 turns

traits.name: Iron Fist
traits.description: The first taijutsu or unarmed attack you make each turn adds +1d4 to the attack and damage rolls

traits.name: Iron Mind
traits.description: Advantage on Intelligence Saving throws and ability checks.

traits.name: Kage Support
traits.description: Help Action can target up to 2 allied creatures, up to 30 feet away.

traits.name: Lethal Hunter
traits.description: Ranged weapon attacks gain a +1 bonus to damage die, and increase damage dealt with ranged taijutsu attack using that weapon by 1 die.

traits.name: Life Eater
traits.description: When you deal damage that reduces a creature to 0 hit points, that creature cannot be revived by any means.

traits.name: Light Weapon Expert
traits.description: While wielding a weapon with the light weapon property,  make 1 additional attack.

traits.name: Lion Fist
traits.description: As an bonus action select one creature within 60 feet, forcing them to make a Wisdom save vs your highest save DC. On a failure, they gain one rank of the fear condition for the next minute against you. A feared creature can spend its action to remake the save in an attempt to remove all ranks of fear it currently has as a result of this trait.

traits.name: Long Lasting Grudge
traits.description: Select one Hidden Village or Country. You gain a bonus to attack and damage against creatures from that village or country equal to 1/6th your level.

traits.name: Martial Advantage
traits.description: Once per turn deal extra damage equal to half your level when you hit a target creature, while within 5ft of allied creatures.

traits.name: Medic Adept
traits.description: You cannot lose concentration on a Jutsu with the medical keyword as a result of damage.

traits.name: Medic Expert
traits.description: Twice per combat, as an action you can automatically end any condition affecting an allied creature. Additionally, Jutsu with the medical Keyword that restores hit points, cannot be reacted to.

traits.name: Medic Master
traits.description: Twice per combat, as an action, all allied creatures within 30 feet of you regain 50 hit points.

traits.name: Mist Sight
traits.description: You can see in any form of mist, smoke, haze or obscuring gases, even if made as a result of a jutsu.

traits.name: Parry
traits.description: As a reaction, gain +3 AC against all melee attacks that you can see until the beginning of your next turn.

traits.name: Poisoner
traits.description: Poison Damage you deal, deals an additional damage equal to your level, once per turn.

traits.name: Power of Age
traits.description: Select 2 Damage types. Ignore resistance and immunity with the chosen damage types and gain a +2 bonus to critical threat range with the chosen damage types. Select 3 damage types, gain vulnerability to the chosen damage type. This vulnerability cannot be removed or counteracted.

traits.name: Power of Ignorance
traits.description: Select 1 Ability score. Automatically pass all saves with the chosen ability score. Select 2 Ability scores. Automatically fail all saves with the chosen ability score. This vulnerability cannot be removed or counteracted.

traits.name: Power of Pride
traits.description: Select 2 conditions. Gain Immunity to the chosen conditions. Select 3 conditions. Gain vulnerability to the chosen conditions. This vulnerability cannot be removed or counteracted.

traits.name: Power of Youth
traits.description: While Bloodied (50% Hp), roll 1d10 at the beginning of each of your turns. On a roll of 7~10, regain 1/5th your level d12 hit points and chakra.

traits.name: Powerful Penetration
traits.description: Select one Damage type. Ignore resistance for the chosen damage type.

traits.name: Protect the Young
traits.description: While standing next to a younger or lower classed/ranked ally, can spend a reaction to redirect the attack to yourself.

traits.name: Puppet Tool
traits.description: (This trait does not count against your known trait slots). You are a Puppet, designed to serve the will of your Puppet Master. You do not have turns. Instead, the Puppet Master controls you to take your turn by spending either their action, bonus action, or spending an amount of chakra equal to your adversary rank (D-Rank: 3, C-Rank: 6, B-Rank: 9, A-Rank: 12, S-Rank: 15). You can take a reaction without any input from your Puppet Master. If your Puppet Master is unable to take actions, you cannot take actions either.

traits.name: Ranged Weapon Expert
traits.description: While wielding a Ranged Weapon or a weapon with the thrown property, you can make +1 additional attack with the attack action. (Already Added)

traits.name: Redirect
traits.description: When you are within 5ft of another creature, if you are the target of a melee attack, you can spend a reaction. When you do, make Dexterity saving throw vs the targets attack Save DC. (If unarmed or weapon, vs Taijutsu save DC.). On a success, you redirect the attack to another creature within 5 feet of you, regardless if ally or hostile.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: You regain 1/10th of your maximum hit points at the start of each of your turns. This regeneration stops for 1 turn if you are hit by a specific damage type (Select one) or you are reduced to 0 hit points.

traits.name: Siege Master
traits.description: Deal quadruple damage to objects, structures and constructs.

traits.name: Unrivaled Tactics
traits.description: Creatures who fail a saving throw as a result of a jutsu you cast that would inflict a condition, cannot remove the condition through jutsu with the Medical Keyword while you are within 120 feet of them. Creatures who would attempt to end a condition as a result of the condition allowing them to make an ability check or saving throw, make their check/save with a 1d12 penalty to the result.

traits.name: Aura: Entanglement
traits.description: The ground in a 30 ft radius around this adversary is treated as difficult terrain for hostile creatures. Each hostile creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a Strength saving throw vs DC 10 + Level or have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of their current turn. This trait can be temporarily deactivated if this adversary is targeted by a special effect such as C-Rank Chakra dispel or Uzumaki Break. You can change the effect or jutsu needed to one your party has such as a specific condition, Action or damage type. The aura is deactivated until the end of this adversaries next turn.

traits.name: Distraction
traits.description: Creatures who fail a saving throw as a result of a jutsu you cast, attacks made on their next turn suffer a 1d4 penalty.

traits.name: Get Into Position
traits.description: When you would withold your action to cast a jutsu in response to a hostile or allied creatures actions, you can, as a part of the same action, command up to 2 allies to move up to 30 feet into any space that can hold them.

traits.name: Overwhelming Presence
traits.description: Creatures who attempt to make a Wisdom or Charisma ability check against you, make their checks at disadvantage. Additionally, when you would make a Chrisma Ability Check roll at advantage.

traits.name: Aura: Chakra Disruption
traits.description: When a Hostile creature would attempt to cast a Jutsu that requires Chakra Molding while they are within 30 feet of this adversary, they must make a Constitution save. vs a DC 10 + Level. On a failed save, their jutsu fails and their chakra is spent. This trait can be temporarily deactivated if this adversary is targeted by a special effect such as C-Rank Chakra dispel or Uzumaki Break. You can change the effect or jutsu needed to one your party has such as a specific condition, Action or damage type. The aura is deactivated until the end of this adversaries next turn.

traits.name: Knockback
traits.description: Creatures who fail a saving throw as a result of a jutsu you cast that would forcefully move them, you double the forced movement distance.

traits.name: Manipulative Control
traits.description:
A hostile creature under the effects of a jutsu you are concentrating on suffers a -1 penalty to their AC based on the rank of the Jutsu.
D-Rank: -1, C-RanK: -2, B-Rank: -3, A-Rank: -4, S-Rank: -5.

traits.name: Crippling Strike
traits.description: Creatures who fail a saving throw as a result of a jutsu you cast, they are temporarily crippled, being unable to cast jutsu with the Mobility (M) component until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Stance Break
traits.description: You can use your reaction to initiate a Clash with a creatures jutsu, by casting a jutsu you know with a cast time of 1 action. Additionally, the triggering creature rolls at disadvantage.

traits.name: Aura: Destabilization
traits.description:
Select one Ability score (Any)
Range: 30ft Aura (Hostile Creatures)
Effect: Creatures suffer a -2 penalty to the chosen save. This trait can be disabled by an effect such as an A-Rank Chakra dispel or Uzumaki Break. You can change the effect or jutsu needed to one your party has such as a specific condition, Action or damage type. Disabled until the end of this adversaries next turn.

traits.name: Aura: Reversal
traits.description:
Range: 30ft Aura (Hostile Creatures)
Creatures in range who have a bonus to their attacks or damage as a result of a Jutsu or class feature, it is instead turned into a penalty. This trait can be temporarily deactivated if this adversary is targeted by a special effect such as A-Rank Chakra dispel or Uzumaki Break. You can change the effect or jutsu needed to one your party has such as a specific condition, Action or damage type. Disabled until the end of this adversaries next turn.

traits.name: Guardian
traits.description: When you would cast a jutsu that would reduce damage, increase your or an allied creatures AC, or provide temporary hit points, All allied creatures within 15ft of you gain the benefit of the jutsu cast. They maintain the benefit of the jutsu for the same duration you benefit from it.

traits.name: Got Your Back
traits.description: When standing within 15ft to an ally or attacking target, you can spend your reaction to redirect the attack onto yourself.

traits.name: Impenetrable
traits.description: Pick one: Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing. You gain Resistance to the chosen damage type.

traits.name: Protector
traits.description: As a bonus action, mark one allied creature. A marked allied creature cannot be knocked prone, and have advantage on saving throws to resist Physical Conditions.

traits.name: Don't Look Away
traits.description: As a Bonus action, you can mark one creature you see in initiative. A marked target has -1d6 penalty to any attack roll that doesn't include you. You can have one active mark at a time, and marks don't stack.

traits.name: Genjutsu Resistance
traits.description: Select one keyword from the following; Auditory, Visual, Inhale, Tactile. You have disadvantage on saving throws against Genjutsu with the chosen keyword.

traits.name: Get Behind Me
traits.description: Allied creatures within 15ft of you are treated as if they have a +2 bonus to their AC. (This does not include you)

traits.name: Heavy Defence
traits.description: Your defence is impenetrable. Creatures cannot ignore your Temporary hit points regardless of their features effects.

traits.name: Chakra Protection
traits.description: Select two damage types. Gain Resistance to the select damage types. If you have vulnerability to a chosen damage type as the result of a different trait, you cannot gain resistance to that chosen damage type.

traits.name: Fortress
traits.description: The first instance of damage you take each turn is reduced by your level. This trait can be temporarily deactivated if this adversary is targeted by an B-Rank Chakra dispel. The trait is deactivated until the end of this adversaries next turn.

traits.name: Critical Defence
traits.description: Immune to Critical Hits and any Critical hit based effects, unless you are already bloodied (50%HP). A critical hit does not guarentee an automatic hit against you.

traits.name: Vanguard
traits.description: Allies within 15ft of you have a +2 bonus to all saving throws.

traits.name: Slayer
traits.description: When you would deal damage to a creature who is bloodied (Has less than 50% of its maximum hit points), increase the damage you deal by 3 damage die, once per turn.

traits.name: Can't escape
traits.description: When a hostile creature would attempt to disengage or move more than 5 feet away from you while you are engaged with them, you can cast a Jutsu as a reaction to that movement.

traits.name: Murder
traits.description: When you hit a creature with an attack while you are hidden, the attack automatically is treated as a critical hit. When you score a critical in this way, you do not add modifiers of any type and only roll double the damage die. You can trigger this trait, once per turn.

traits.name: Lethal Edge
traits.description: When you score a critical hit with an attack you make, make one additional weapon attack as a part of that same action.

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.description: Once per turn, you deal an extra, 1/2 level d8 damage when you hits a target with an attack and have advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of your ally, as long as you don't have disadvantage

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: Gain a Burrow speed equal to your movement speed.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.description: While in dim light or darkness, you can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Additionally, while hidden, you make no sound while moving and cannot be tracked by any means that require vision.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.description: When you are hidden, hostile creatures cannot spot you with passive perception.

traits.name: Hide In Plain Sight
traits.description: You can attempt to hide when behind even partial cover or while lightly obscured.

traits.name: Primary Target
traits.description: As a bonus action, mark one creature you can see within 60 feet. A creature marked by this feature cannot gain the benefits of stealth against you.

traits.name: Shadow Step
traits.description: Once per turn, you can spend your Bonus action to teleport to one hostile creature who is in bright light as you appear from their shadow. If you do, you must spend a Bonus action to recharge this trait.

traits.name: Dead to Rights
traits.description: When you would reduce a creatures hit points to 0, they automatically fail 2 death saving throws, and make their next death saving throw with a 1d4 penalty.

traits.name: Superior Potential
traits.description: Once per combat, when you would cast a Jutsu, maximize the damage, double the range, and  gain advantage on the attack roll or impose disadvantage on the save. Once you do this, until the end of your next turn, you are Paralyzed.

traits.name: Superior Technique
traits.description: Select one Trait from either the Caster, Striker or Defender. Replace this trait with that one. (You may need to switch this adversaries Role in order to make your selection. But when you have made your selection, swith the role back to Generalist.)

traits.name: Superior Power
traits.description: Twice per turn, add your level in damage in place of your ability modifier to a damage roll you make.

traits.name: Jack of All
traits.description: You gain half proficiency in all of skills and saves you are not proficient in.

traits.name: You Can't Hide
traits.description: You have advantage when trying to detect hidden enemies. Any enemy that you can see is also visible to your allies.

traits.name: Superior Skill
traits.description: When you make an Ability check with a skill you are proficient in, you may add 1d6 to your check. Additionally, If your Ability checks are ever contested, you instead add 2d6.

traits.name: Superior Ability
traits.description: When you would make a saving throw vs any hostile jutsu or feature, you may add 1d6 to the saving throw. You may only do this once before the beginning of each of your turns.

traits.name: Explorer
traits.description: You gain a +20 movement speed bonuses, can climb, water and wall walk without any movement penalty and ignore difficult terrain and terrain that imposes movement penalties.

traits.name: Hard to Hit
traits.description: When you are standing and unrestained, attacks against you have a 1d6 penalty unless you are adjacent to two or more enemies.

traits.name: Light-Footed
traits.description: You can Disengage or Dash as a bonus action. When an enemy moves adjacent to you, you can spend your reaction to move away up to half your speed.

traits.name: Pincer Movement
traits.description: When an ally moves adjacent to an enemy, you can spend your reaction to move up to your speed towards that same enemy.

traits.name: King of the Hill
traits.description: When you are the only creature alive or conscious, while outnumbered by hostile enemies. You gain advantage on all Attack rolls , Ability checks and saving throws so long as you are not adjacent to more than 2 hostile creatures. This trait can be temporarily deactivated if this adversary is targeted by a special effect such as S-Rank Chakra dispel or Uzumaki Break. You can change the effect or jutsu needed to one your party has such as a specific condition, Action or damage type. The aura is deactivated until the end of this adversaries next turn.

traits.name: Chakra Protection
traits.description: When you would take damage, as a reaction, you can convert all Hit point damage to Chakra damage until the end of the current turn.

traits.name: Life Conversion
traits.description: You can convert Hit 4 Hit points into 1 Chakra. When you do, jutsu cast that turn increase their damage by 1 step and you must spend the entire cost of the jutsu with the converted Hit Points.

traits.name: Efficient Casting
traits.description: Ninjutsu you cast cannot have their costs increased.

traits.name: Primalist Wrath

Ninjutsu you cast that deals Poison, Acid, or Necrotic damage to a targets HP automatically inflicts 1 rank fo the following conditions, once per casting;

Acid - Corroded.

traits.name: Transmogrified Casting
traits.description: When you cast a jutsu that imposes a Strength saving throw, you can double the jutsu's cost to change to saving throw to a Dexterity saving throw, and vice versa. This trait only applies to initial saving throws imposes by the jutsu and does not persist through multiple rounds.

traits.description: If you cast a Ninjutsu that requires an attack roll, and you would miss, you can choose to spend double jutsu's cost to reroll the attack. You can only use this trait, once per casting.

traits.name: Scattershot
traits.description: When you cast a Ninjutsu that requires an attack roll, compare the result of the attack to all creatures of your choice within 5ft of the initial target AC, treating each one as if they were also the original target dealing the jutsus damage and effects to them as well.

traits.description:
Frequency: Once per turn
Effect: On a successful hit vs a creature who has of the Dazed, Staggered, Concussed or Restrained Conditions, deal the maximum possible damage with a Ninjutsu you cast. Once you use this trait, you cannot use it again until you spend at least 1 round not casting Ninjutsu with your Action or Bonus Action.

traits.name: Strikers Focus
traits.description: As an action, you focus, being unable to attack in any way for the remainder of the turn. At the beginning of your next turn, you gain advantage on all attack rolls made until the end of that turn. On a successful hit, deal additional damage to each attack made equal to your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Chakra Fury
traits.description: When a creature takes damage from your Ninjutsu Attack, you gain a +2 bonus to your next Ninjutsu attack roll vs a different target on the following turn. This bonus always resets at the end of your following turn.

traits.name: Rampage
traits.description: When you reduce a target to 0 hit points with a melee attack on your turn, gain an additional action which must be spent to perform the same melee attack, jutsu, feature or trait against the next closest hostile creature. (Recharge 5-6)

traits.name: Cleave
traits.description: When you would make a Melee Weapon attack against a creature who has another creature within 5 feet of them, you can choose to deal your attacks damage to both, if you score a hit.

traits.name: Press the Attack
traits.description: You gain a +2 bonus on Ninjutsu attacks vs creatures who are currently benefiting from a bonus to their AC as the result of a Jutsu they cast this round.

traits.name: Savage Assault
traits.description:
Frequency: Once per turn.
Effect: When you deal damage to a creature with a Ninjutsu attack, you can choose to make an additional attack as a part of the same action at a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If you would score a successful hit, you can repeat this attack one additional time. Until the beginning of your next turn, creatures gain advantage on attacks targeting you after using this trait.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the beginning of your turn you can choose to gain advantage on all melee attacks OR advantage on your damage rolls you make for that turn. However, hostile creatures gain the same benefit targeting you until the beginning of your next turn

traits.name: Jutsu of War
traits.description: Each time you cast a Jutsu, you can make an additional weapon attack as a part of the same action used to cast the jutsu.

traits.name: Revenge
traits.description: You can deal 2d6 bonus damage to any creature that harmed you in any way in the previous round. (This includes damage, penalties, conditions, or forced movement)

traits.name: Savage Flurry
traits.description: As a bonus action after taking the attack acton, cast one Ninjutsu that requires an attack role of the lowest rank known.

traits.name: First Impressions
traits.description: Creatures cannot take reactions against you, the first time they would see you cast a Ninjutsu for the first time against them. If you would cast the same jutsu, all creatures who could see it cast, are unaffected by this trait.

traits.description: Twice per combat, you can scream out a battle plan. All hostile creatures, make a Wisdom  check vs DC 5 + Your Level. On a failed check, the target gains disadvantage on attacks against all of your allies until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Tactical Focus
traits.description: At the beginning of combat, when initiative it rolled, roll initiative at disadvantage. All allies roll their initiatives adding 1d8 to the result of their initiative.

traits.name: Helpful
traits.description: You can perform the Help Action as a bonus action, targeting up to 2 allied creatures up to 30 feet away.

traits.name: Aura: Defensive Commands
traits.description: Allies within 30ft of you can take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Aura: Recovery
traits.description: Allies within 30ft of you who would regain hit points, regain additional hit points equal to half your level.

traits.name: Tenacious Support
traits.description: If you roll inititaitve with an allied creature who is classed as an Elite or Solo, they begin combat with additional Tenacity die equal to 1/3rd your level. Alternatively, if initiative is rolled while not allied with a creature who is classed as an Elite or Solo, but instead a Standard, those allied gain a number of tenacity die equal to 1/6th your level, which are d4's.

traits.name: Iconic Strength
traits.description: When you would deal damage using your strength that adds your ability modifier, you instead use 2 times your Strength modifier for calculating their damage and saving throw. Finally, this adversary cannot make Strength ability checks or saving throws at disadvantage.

traits.name: Iconic Will
traits.description: You are immune to effects that would alter your mental state, change your personality or disposition or force you to act against your will. Also, when you would make a saving throw of any type, and you succeed by 5 or more, you regain 1 tenacity die.

traits.name: Iconic Reflexes
traits.description: You gain a +30 bonus to your movement speed, cannot have your speed reduced by any means, ignore difficult terrain, and have advantage on all abilitiy checks and saving throws made to resist the grappled, slowed, weakened, and restrained conditions. Additionally, when you would succeed on a Dexterity saving throw, you ignore its effects.

traits.name: Iconic Power
traits.description: Treat Immunity as Resistance. Ignore Resistance. Damage Reduction is always treated as half its value against your damage.

traits.name: Iconic Resistance
traits.description: You are resistant to all damage unless it would deal twice your level in damage during a single instance, attack roll, or saving throw.

traits.name: Iconic Focus
traits.description: You cannot lose concentration on a Jutsu, feature or trait as a result of damage. When a creature would attempt to remove your ability to mold chakra you make your saving throws or ability checks to resist at advantage.

traits.name: Iconic Presence
traits.description: You are immune to Charisma based ability checks, effects, or interactions. You cannot be charmed, freightened or controlled by other creatures. Also, you have advantage on all saving throws or ability checks vs Fuinjutsu.

traits.name: Iconic Legacy
traits.description: You have the blood of legends in their veins. You can learn any Hijutsu regardless of clan limitations. All of your Jutsu gain the Hijutsu keyword and cannot be learned or copied. Additionally, you can gain 2 additional Clan Traits of your choice from any Clan.

traits.name: Iconic Tenacity [T. Die]
traits.description: You gain additional Tenacity die equal to half your level.

traits.name: Iconic Tenacity [L. Resistance]
traits.description: You gain 3 additional uses of Legendary Resistance.

traits.name: Iconic Aura
traits.description: Allies within 30ft of you gain a +2 bonus to their Attack rolls, AC, Saving throws and ability checks.

traits.name: Iconic Force
traits.description: Creatures that would make a saving throw to resist a jutsu you cast reduces their saving throw by 1d4.

traits.name: Iconic Reactions
traits.description: You have additional reactions equal to 1/4th your level you can use per round. You can still only use one reaction per turn.

traits.name: Iconic Awareness
traits.description: You are aware of all hostile creatures location within 300 feet of them. You are also aware of all jutsu and proficiencies hostile creatures within 120 of you have.

traits.name: Bug Host
traits.description: When you would make a Constitution saving throw to resist a condition of any type add 1d4 to the roll.

traits.name: Chakra Network Damage
traits.description: When you would deal damage with Aburame Clan jutsu, affected creatures increase the cost of the next jutsu they cast by half.

traits.name: Parasites

traits.name: Beetles
traits.description: When you cast an Aburame Clan Hijutsu, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level as your body is covered in bettle carapace armor, until the beginning of your next turn.

traits.name: Kikaichu Swarm
traits.description: Aburame Clan jutsu you cast leaves behind a trail of insects. Creatures affected by your Jutsu, cannot gain the benefits of stealth or cover against you, until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Fatso Fortitude
traits.description: When making an ability check to end a Physical or elemental condition, make a Constitution saving throw instead.

traits.name: Green Spinich Pill
traits.description: By spending 2 Tenacity die, this adversary gains immunity to the Bruised condition for 1 minute.

traits.name: Yellow Curry Pill
traits.description: By spending 5 Tenacity die this adversary gains immunity to the Dazed conditions for 1 minute.

traits.name: Red Chili Pill
traits.description: By spending 9 Tenacity die, this adversary gains immunity to forced movement, the restrained and grappled conditions and cannot have its Strength or Constitution ability scores or damage penalized or reduced by hostile effects for 1 minute.

traits.name: Fatso
traits.description: Akimichi Clan jutsu you cast grants you Temporary Hit Points equal to your Level until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Amazing Accuracy
traits.description: When you target a creature, ignore all cover short of total cover.

traits.name: Serrated Edges
traits.description: Ranged Weapon attacks that get 10 or more over the targets AC, inflicts 1 rank of bleed.

traits.name: Lethal Precision
traits.description: Critical hits made with ranged weapon attacks add +2 damage die to the result.

traits.name: Tireless Focus
traits.description: Ranged weapon attacks you make, cannot be made at disadvantage.

traits.name: Falling Heaven
traits.description: Fuma Clan jutsu you cast ignore resistance and treats immunity as resistance.

traits.name: White Chakra
traits.description: Jutsu with the Lightning Release keyword, cost is treated as if it were 1 rank lower.

traits.name: Lightning Adept
traits.description: Jutsu cast with the lightning Release Keyword of C-Rank or lower, does not require Handsigns (HS)

traits.name: Lightning Sabre
traits.description: Weapon Attacks you make deal lightning damage.

traits.name: Aura of Lightning
traits.description: You gain Resistance to Lightning Damage & Immunity to the Shocked condition.

traits.name: Purple Lightning
traits.description: Recharge (3-4): When you would deal Lightning damage to a creature with a Ninjutsu of C-Rank or Higher, the target must succeed a Constitution saving throw vs your Ninjutsu Save DC, being shocked on a Failed save.

traits.name: Serpent Senses
traits.description: You have 30 feet of Darkvision, and 15 feet of Tremor Sense

traits.name: Regeneration

traits.name: Potent Poison

traits.name: Death Rattle

traits.description: Ninjutsu you cast with the Water Release Keyword of C-Rank or lower, does not require Handsigns (HS)

traits.name: Apex Predator

traits.name: Shark Skin
traits.description: You gain a bonus to AC equal to your Constitution Modifier.

traits.name: Wrath of the Deep

traits.name: Prime Byakugan
traits.description: 60ft of True sight and +5 to Passive Perception

traits.name: Prime Gentle Fist
traits.description: Unarmed damage is instead 3d6, and chakra damage dealt to a creature with 0 chakra instead deals twice as much force damage to targets

traits.name: Can't Fool the Byakugan
traits.description: Creatures within 120 feet of you do not gain advantage against you when attempting to stealth. If they would have advantage against other creatures, they make their roll at advantage, but calculate their stealth as if they disadvantage only in regards to you.

traits.name: Combat Insight
traits.description: Once per turn, if you would make an attack targeting a creature who has not yet acted this round, add 1d4 to the attack roll against that target.

traits.name: Perfect Chakra Control
traits.description: Jutsu, features and effects that would cause you to increase the cost of jutsu you cast or deal chakra damage to you, is reduced by your unarmed damage die, once per turn.

traits.name: Nin-Dog Attack
traits.description: You can use a bonus action to have an ally (beast only) make a single melee attack.

traits.name: Beast Master
traits.description: When your Nin-Dog would take damage you can command it, as a reaction to reposition itself to a space adjacent to you. When you it gains resistance to that instance of damage, and moves up to twice its full movement to accomplish your order.

traits.name: Pact Tactics
traits.description: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature If at least one of your allies are within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Feral Ability
traits.description: So long as you can smell, your passive perception cannot be lowered.

traits.name: Bestial Fury
traits.description: When an allied beast within 30 feet of you scores an attack you can use your reaction to cast an Inuzuka clan jutsu.

traits.name: Dead Bone Pulse
traits.description: Kaguya Clan Jutsu and Weapon attacks made with Bone Weapons, cannot be made at Disadvantage.

traits.name: Bone Weapon Enhancement
traits.description: Bone weapons you summon increase their damage die by 1 step.

traits.name: Battle Hungry
traits.description: Each turn you spend your action dealing damage to a creature with a weapon attack or Kaguya clan Hijutsu, you gain a +1 bonus to damage. This bonus is lost if you spend your action performing any other action other than the attack action with a bone weapon or casting a Kaguya clan Hijutsu

traits.name: Shikotsumayaku Technique
traits.description: Twice per combat, perform a Shinkotsumayaku Dancing flurish. All hostile creatures of your choice must make a Dexterity save vs your Taijutsu save DC. On a failed save, they take Xd6 + your Taijutsu ability mod and gain 3 ranks of bleeding. X = Your level.

traits.name: Savage Battle Instincts
traits.description: You cannot be surprised and creatures cannot get advantage on attacks against you

traits.name: Genjutsu Resistance
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws to save against Genjutsu.

traits.name: Careful Genjutsu
traits.description: When you cast a Genjutsu that forces creatures to make a saving throw, you can choose to have your allies be unaffected.

traits.name: Enhanced Genjutsu
traits.description: Twice per encounter when a target rolls a saving throw against a Genjutsu you cast, you can use as a reaction give them disadvantage on the saving throw.

traits.name: Layered Genjutsu
traits.description: When a creature under the effects of your Genjutsu succeeds a saving throw you can use your reaction to cast a second Genjutsu on the same creature.

traits.name: Genjutsu Conversion
traits.description: You can use your Genjutsu DC, Attack Bonus, and Ability score for Ninjutsu of C-Rank or lower.

traits.name: Yin Chakra Molding
traits.description: Kuru Clan Hijutsu you cast can imitate any one nature release of your choice. Select One nature release from a jutsu on your known list. That jutsu loses its nature release keyword and deals Necrotic Damage.

traits.name: Yin Chakra Adept
traits.description: Jutsu you cast, without a Nature Release keyword, has its Damage die both increase by +1.

traits.name: Chronographic Trance
traits.description: When you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may use your Reaction to instead remain at 1, as you barely dodge out of the way of the fatal attack.

traits.name: Shadow Techniques
traits.description: Twice per encounter, when you would deal Necrotic Damage, you deal additional Necrotic Damage equal to your level.

traits.name: Yin Chakra Imitation
traits.description: All jutsu you cast with any Nature Release Keyword deals Necrotic Damage.

traits.name: Coordinate
traits.description: As an action you can direct allies within 30 feet of you, giving them a +1d4 bonus to attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

traits.name: Master Tactician
traits.description: As a bonus action you can give an ally you can see a tenacity die which  can be added to any saving throw they make. An ally can have up to 3 of these die at any one time.

traits.name: Genius Potential
traits.description: You have advantage on intelligence saving throws.

traits.name: Shadow Possesion
traits.description: Twice per encounter you can increase the DC of a Nara Jutsu you are casting by +1

traits.name: Finger Break
traits.description: You can expend 20 hit points to end a Genjutsu effect you are under. This does not require an action.

traits.name: Self-Taught Skills
traits.description: You cannot make ability checks with a jutsu based penalty of any type.

traits.name: Never Back Down
traits.description: When an ally you can see falls to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to gain advantage on attack rolls and all saves until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Never Give Up
traits.description: Twice per encounter when your hit points would fall to 0 they instead fall to 1 and cannot fall to 0 until the end of the current turn.

traits.name: Never Abandon a Friend
traits.description: When an ally you can see falls to 0 hit points, you can, on your turn, use an action to move up to your ally and restore hit points to them equal to your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Limitless Potential
traits.description: Twice per encounter when you make an attack roll, ability check or saving throw you can add an additional 1d6 to the roll.

traits.name: Blood of The Dragon
traits.description: Gain Immunity to your chosen Nature Release, and resistance to that nature releases inferior counterpart.

traits.name: Elemental Savagry
traits.description: When dealing Earth, Wind, Fire, Cold, or Lightning damage with a Ryu Hijutsu, ignore resistance and treat immunity as resistance, once per turn.

traits.name: Relentless Assault
traits.description: When making an unarmed or weapon attack, choose to spend a bonus action to make two additional unarmed or weapon attacks. These attacks cannot be made at disadvantage.

traits.name: Dragons wrathful Aura
traits.description: Your wrathful chakra radiates from you. All hostile creatures who begins their turns within 15 feet of your suffers a -1 penalty to their AC until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Dragons Wrath
traits.description: When a hostile creature would make a saving throw to resist your Hijutsu's effects you can spend 15 chakra or 1 tenacity die to increase the save DC by +1.

traits.name: Advanced Chakra Transformation
traits.description: You cannot have your chakra molding removed by any means.

traits.name: Advanced Chakra Control
traits.description: Twice times per encounter when you cast a Ninjutsu that does not require concentation you can treat its Chakra cost as if it were 1 rank lower.

traits.name: Strong Natures
traits.description: When clashing with Ninjutsu of a superior element you roll at advantage.

traits.name: Adaptive Elements
traits.description: Twice per encounter when you cast a Ninjutsu with a nature element type, you can choose to change its damage type to the same as another Elemental Ninjutsu you can cast.

traits.name: Elemental Weapons
traits.description: As a bonus action you can coat a melee weapon. The weapon while in your possession deals an additional 1d4 damage with melee weapon attacks.

traits.name: Third Eye
traits.description: You gain a +5 to passive perception and perception checks made using sight, and can make ranged weapon attacks at double their normal range until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Web Weapons
traits.description: Hand Scythes, Quarterstaffs, Whips, Longbows, Shortbow’s & bow ammunition (arrows) you wield are enhanced with web and score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20

traits.name: Exoskeleton
traits.description: As an action you can spend 20 chakra to increase your AC by 2 and gain 30 temporary hit points for one minute, or until the temporary hit points are gone.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: You gain a climbing speed equal to you walking speed and cannot be knocked prone on any solid surface.

traits.name: Web pull
traits.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack you can pull them 10 feet closer to you.

traits.name: Sharingan Dodge
traits.description: As a reaction you can add a +2 bonus to your AC and Dexterity Saving Throws until the start of your next turn.

traits.name: Copy Wheel
traits.description: Twice per encounter when a creature you can see casts a jutsu within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to cast the same jutsu at that creature.

traits.name: Genjutsu Counter
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws to save against Genjutsu.

traits.name: Amplifed Defense
traits.description: Three times per encounter you can take an additional reaction.

traits.name: Feinting Attack
traits.description: As a bonus action select a creature you can see, you gain advantage on the next attack roll you make against it, and deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus

traits.name: Fuinjutsu Master
traits.description: Ninjutsu with the Fuinjutsu Keyword has an increased DC of +1.

traits.name: Wellspring of Chakra
traits.description: You are immune to chakra cost increase effects.

traits.name: Fundamental Difference
traits.description: You can use Constitution for Attack and Damage rolls, as well as Save DC for Ninjutsu you cast with the Fuinjutsu Keyword.

traits.name: Inhuman Lifeforce
traits.description: Whenever you make a constitution saving throw you add your proficiency bonus twice.

traits.name: Incomprehensible Fortitude
traits.description: Twice per encounter when you make a Constitution Saving Throw you can choose to automatically succeed and suffer no effects of the triggering effect.

traits.name: Master Mental Alteration
traits.description: Twice per encounter when you use a Yamanaka Clan Jutsu you may deal 3d10 Phychic damage in addition to the Jutsu's effect.

traits.name: Adept Transfer
traits.description: A Creature who fails a saving throw inflicted by a Genjutsu you cast, suffers a 1d4 penalty.

traits.name: Mental Domination
traits.description: Twice per encounter when using Yamanaka Clan Genjutsu you may increase the saving throw by 2.

traits.name: Awakened Mind
traits.description: You gain Telepathy with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Efficient Mind
traits.description: Yamanaka clan Hijutsu you cast cannot have their cost increased by hostile effects

traits.name: Ice Release
traits.description: When you cast Jutsu with the Wind Release or Water Release Keyword you can change its damage type to cold, and deal an additional die of damage.

traits.name: Chilled Body
traits.description: You have resistance to Cold Damage.

traits.name: Frigid Cold
traits.description: Whenever you would deal damage to a creature who has ranks of chilled, they suffer the effects of chilled as if it were the beginning of their turn. You can only trigger chilled in this way, once per turn, per creature.

traits.name: Frostbite
traits.description: Whenever you deal Cold Damage, you deal additional cold damage equal to proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Frost
traits.description: When you a creature is affected by your Yuki Clan Hijutsu, they gain a stack of Chilled. For every 2 stacks of Chilled they have, they gain 1 rank of Slowed.

traits.name: Explosive Techniques
traits.description: When you cast a jutsu with the Earth or Lightning Release Keyword, you can change its damage type to force.

traits.name: Catalysmic
traits.description: You deal triple damage to structures. Additionally you always deal maximum damage to structures

traits.name: Explosion Release
traits.description: Bakuton Clan Jutsu have their range increased by 20 feet. Additionally Area of Effect Bakuton Jutsu increase their radius by 10 feet as well.

traits.name: Bombastic
traits.description: When you deal damage with a Bakuton Jutsu, you deal additional damage equal to 2d4, twice per turn.

traits.name: Explosive Art
traits.description: You deal  double damage to constructs. Additionally damage you deal to constructs can never be reduced below half.

traits.name: Coorrosive Blood
traits.description: Once per turn, when you take damage, all creatures within 5 feet of you takes Acid damage equal to your level.

traits.name: Corrosive Arts
traits.description: Once per turn, when you deal Acid Damage to a creature holding a weapon with weapon seals, the weapon becomes brittle. If you deal damage to that same creature holding the same weapon three times this combat, the weapon is permanently damaged suffering a -2 penalty to hit and damage. A weapon that suffers this traits effects twice in any single combat is destroyed. A creature with a weapon damaged by this weapon can repair it with the Mending Jutsu.

traits.name: Corrosive Aura
traits.description: Once per turn, When you cast a Futton Clan Hijutsu, all creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Constitution save vs your Ninjutsu save DC. On a failed save they gain the corroded condition.

traits.name: Boiling Chakra
traits.description: As an action you spend 25 chakra to increase your Strength or Dexterity bonus by +4 until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Boiling Aura
traits.description: As an action you can spend 20 chakra per creature within 10 feet of you, to increase the selected creatures AC by +2 until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Water Dependant
traits.description: While you are within 120 feet of a source of water at least 10 feet deep, you are immune to difficult terrain.

traits.name: Made of Water
traits.description: Your body counts as a sufficient source of water for reducing the cost of Water release jutsu.

traits.name: Water Reservoirs
traits.description: Increase the damage of Water jutsu by your Proficiency bonus once per jutsu casting.

traits.name: Reflective Surface
traits.description: When you cast a Ninjutsu with the water release keyword, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level.

traits.name: Well of Me
traits.description: As a reaction, you can add +2 to your ac against any melee or ranged attack. If you use this feature against an attack with the lightning release keyword or that deals lightning damage, you instead gaina -5 penalty to your AC.

traits.name: Magnet Techniques
traits.description: When you deal damage with a jutsu that deals Earth or Wind damage, you can switch it to earth damage. Additionally you mark the damaged creature. A marked creature grants you advantage on your next attack against the target creature.

traits.name: Magnet Release
traits.description: When you deal damage with a Jiton Clan Hijutsu, you may increase the damage die by 1 step.

traits.name: Magnetic Mark
traits.description: You can as a bonus action mark a creature with with this feature for the next minute. A marked creature takes an additional 1d8 earth damage when they would take Earth or wind damage, once per turn.

traits.name: Swirling Currents
traits.description: When you would be targeted with a weapon attack or bukijutsu, increase your AC by 1d4 or when you would make a saving throw against a Bukijutsu, you gain advantage on the saving throw.

traits.name: Static Cling
traits.description: Creatures marked by Magenetic Mark or by Magnet Techniques cannot gain the benefit of advantage against you.

traits.name: Swift Technique
traits.description: When you cast a Namikaze Hijutsu, you increase your speed by 15, until the beginning of your nex turn.

traits.name: Supernatural Speed
traits.description: When you move your full movement speed you may as an action make a melee weapon attack against each creature you pass dealing your weapon damage + 1d4 to each creature you hit.

traits.name: Quickened Assault
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can spend 10 chakra to make an additional weapon attack. You can spend up to 30 chakra using this feature to make 3 additional weapon attacks. Once you use this Trait, you cannot use it again until you spend your action recharging it.

traits.name: Blink of an Eye
traits.description: When you would move, you instead teleport to the target destination. You can only do this once per turn.

traits.name: Evasive Nature
traits.description: While gaining a boost to movement speed as the result of a Jutsu, gain a +1 bonus to AC.

traits.name: Storm Technique
traits.description: When you would cast a jutsu with the Water Release keyword they deal lightning damage. Additionally When you deal lightning damage, you deal additional damage equal to half your level once per turn.

traits.name: Storm Release
traits.description: When you would deal lightning damage, you deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus. This bonus happens once per turn.

traits.name: Gale Style
traits.description: When you cast a Ranton Clan Hijutsu, you can spend 1 Tenacity die or 30 Chakra to inflict 1 rank of shocked.

traits.name: Pervasive Lightning
traits.description: Lightning damage ignores Resistance.

traits.name: Overload
traits.description: When you deal lightning damage to a creature with the shocked condition, They take an additional 1d4 lightning damage

traits.name: Wood Techniques
traits.description: When you would cast a Water Release or Earth Release Jutsu, you instead deal Earth Damage.

traits.name: Built Different
traits.description: You gain Advantage on constitution saving throws

traits.name: Sacred Body
traits.description: You may use Constitution as your Ninjutsu Ability Modifier.

traits.name: Wood Release
traits.description: A creature restrained, grappled, or slowed or within an area of difficult terrain creature by a Senjutsu Hjutsu that you cast, cannot cast a jutsu with a chakra cost less than your level.

traits.name: Suppression
traits.description: A creature restrained, grappled, or slowed or within an area of difficult terrain creature by a Senjutsu Hjutsu that you cast, must make a Constitution (Chakra Control) check vs your Ninjutsu save DC. On a failed save, for the duration of their condition, they cannot mold chakra.

traits.name: Scorch Technique
traits.description: When you would cast a Fire or Wind Release Jutsu, you instead deal fire damage.

traits.name: Scorching Heat
traits.description: You deal additional damage with Shakuton Clan Hijutsu equal to 2d4 once per turn.

traits.name: Scorch Release
traits.description: When you deal damage with a Shakuton Clan Hijutsu, the target creature gains 1 Rank of the burned condition.

traits.name: Scorching Aura
traits.description: Creatures of your choice who ends their turn within 10 feet of you, takes 4d4 fire damage.

traits.name: Scorching Hell
traits.description: Fire Damage you deal ignores resistance.

traits.name: Shikigami Techniques
traits.description: When you cast a Shikigami Clan Hijutsu, up to twice per combat to increase your damage by 3 damage die.

traits.name: Papercraft
traits.description: When you use a paper based ninja tool, the Save DC's become your Ninjutsu save DC.

traits.name: Paper Expert
traits.description: You always have paper based ninja tools to use.

traits.name: Paper Reservoir
traits.description: Reduce the chakra cost of Shikigami Clan Hijutsu by 1 rank.

traits.name: Divine Shikigami
traits.description: You gain the Divine Shikigami Clan Feature.

traits.name: Lava Techniques
traits.description: When you would cast a Fire or Earth release jutsu, you instead deal fire damage

traits.name: Churning Magma
traits.description: When you would deal damage with a Yoton Hijutsu, you generate a pool of Magma in a 5 foot space on the ground. Creatures that enter, cross through or end their turns within 5 feet of this space, must make a constitution saving throw vs Nin save DC. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of burned.

traits.name: Lava Release
traits.description: When you cast a Yoton Hijutsu, you may increase the damage die by +2.

traits.name: Molten Core
traits.description: Fire damage you deal with Yoton Clan Hijutsu ignores resistance

traits.name: Quicklime
traits.description: As  bonus action, you may force a creature affect by a yoton clan hijutsu this round to make a Strength saving throw vs your Ninjutsu save DC to resist being frozen in place by hardening lava. On a failed save the target is restrained. They repeat the save at the end of each of their turns to end the restrained condition.

traits.name: Demonic Blood
traits.description: The blood of demons, devils, and fiends run through your veins. Select two ability scores. Add 1d6 to saves made with the chosen ability score

traits.name: Demonic Power
traits.description: The power of your demonic heritage is apparant. Add your level to any ninjutsu or Genjutsu damage you deal, once per turn.

traits.name: Demonic Strength
traits.description: The Strength of your demonic heritage is clear. Add your level to any taijutsu or weapon damage you deal, Twice per turn.

traits.name: Demonic Legacy
traits.description: The legacy of your demonic heritage runs deep. At the end of each of your turns you regain Hit points equal to your Level.

traits.name: Demonic Endurance
traits.description: You are immune to all Physical and Mental conditions.

traits.name: Bestial Aggression
traits.description: You have innate aggressive tendencies based on your species. You gain advantage on your first attack made against the last creature that targeted you with an attack.

traits.name: Bestial Instinct
traits.description: As a Reaction you give the first attack made against you disadvantage until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Bestial Pack Tactics
traits.description: When you have an allied creature within 5 feet of a hostile creature. When you make an attack against the hostile creature, you deal additional damage equal to half your level.

traits.name: Bestial Self Preservation
traits.description: When you reach half health. You count as always being under the effects of the dash action when you are moving away from hostile creatures.

traits.name: Bestial Senses
traits.description: Gain a +10 in perception

traits.name: Constructed Fortitude
traits.description: You gain Damage reduction equal to your level against the first instance of damage you take each round.

traits.name: Constructed Strength
traits.description: When making a Dexterity or Constitution ability check or saving throw, you use your Strength modifier in place of either of these ability scores. The save type does not change.

traits.name: Constructed Power
traits.description: You cast Ninjutsu and Genjutsu using your Constitution Ability score

traits.name: Artificial Endurance
traits.description: When you would make an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma Saving throw you instead use your Constitution ability score. The type of save does not change.

traits.name: Augmented Physicality
traits.description: You cannot make a Strength or Constitution saving throw at disadvantage

traits.name: Natural Growth
traits.description: You can increase or decrease your size by 1 category as a bonus action. For each category larger than Medium, you increase your weapon damage die by +1 and reduce your AC by -1. For each category smaller than medium, increase your attack bonus by +1, AC by +1 and speed by +10.

traits.name: Photosynthesis
traits.description: While in sunlight, you recover a number of chakra equal to your Level at the start of each of your turns.

traits.name: Carnivorous
traits.description: When you grapple a creature you can, as an action swallow them. They become restrained and count as being in full cover. While inside you, at the start of each of their turns, they take xd8 necrotic damage (X= half your level). You regain Hit points equal to the damage the swallowed creature took.

traits.name: Mobile
traits.description: You increase your speed by 25 Feet. You gain a burrow speed equal to your movement speed. You also gain 60 feet of tremor sense.

traits.name: Retardant
traits.description: You gain resistance to two damage types of your choice, excluding fire.

traits.name: Ghoul
traits.description: You gain resistance to Saving throws from Ninjutsu

traits.name: Grim
traits.description: Either yourself or your master/leader marks one creature as an Action. While a creature is marked, if their Hit points are less than 50%, they take 2d8 additional necrotic damage from you. Only one creature can be marked at a time.

traits.name: Husk
traits.description: When you deal damage to a creature with a melee weapon attack, you instead reduce their chakra by the damage dealt. You regain the result as hit points.

traits.name: Zombie
traits.description: You wish to feed on the flesh of all living things. Damage you deal cannot be healed by normal means. Creatures whom you bite or hit with your unarmed attack become immune to healing until the beginning of your next turn.

traits.name: Blight
traits.description: A creature that strikes you with a melee attack takes 4d8 necrotic damage.

traits.name: Unnatural Strength
traits.description: Damage you deal that relies on strength adds twice your strength modifier to the damage dealt.

traits.name: Unnatural Ferocity
traits.description: You always have advantage on melee weapon attacks. All creatures always has advantage on attacks against you.

traits.name: Unnatural Toughness
traits.description: You are immune to damage if it deals less than your level.

traits.name: Unnatural Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to damage from jutsu with a Nature Release Keywords

traits.name: Unnatural Power
traits.description: Creatures who make a saving throw against you in any way, are made at disadvantage

traits.name: Sages Strength
traits.description: When you would make a Strength saving throw, you use your Constitution bonus. This still counts as a Strength save.

traits.name: Sages Focus
traits.description: Ninjutsu or Genjutsu you are concentrating on cannot be dispelled while you are concentrating on it.

traits.name: Sages Endurance
traits.description: The first time you would fall to 0 hit points you instead fall to 1.

traits.name: Sages Wisdom
traits.description: The first time you would make an Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma saving throw you automatically succeed.

traits.name: Sage Blooded
traits.description: You are immune to Physical Conditions

traits.name: Modified Biology
traits.description: You are immune to the Bleed, Poisoned or Chilled Conditions. You also cannot be healed as a result of chakra based effects.

traits.name: Modified Physique
traits.description: You are immune to the Weakened, Dazed and Paralyzed conditions.

traits.name: Modified Mind
traits.description: You are immune to the Berserk, Charmed and Fear conditions.

traits.name: Modified Spirit
traits.description: You are immune to effects that would prevent chakra molding and Chakra damage.

traits.name: Modified Constitution
traits.description: You are immune to the Burned, slowed, Dazed and Bruised conditions.

traits.name: Alien Anatomy
traits.description: Jutsu, Features and abilities that would grant its users information about you, such as maximum or current Hit points, Resistances, Jutsu known etc. have a -5 Penalty to the check needed to discern this information. If no check would be made, they instead must complete a  DC 10 + Your level + 5 check using the appropriate ability score or skill.

traits.name: Alien Abilities
traits.description: Ninjutsu and Genjutsu you cast do not count as Jutsu, and instead innate abilities. As a result you can only half the normal amount listed for your level/class/role.

traits.name: Alien Logic
traits.description: When you would clash with a hostile creature, you cannot roll at disadvantage and the opposing creature cannot roll at advantage

traits.name: Alien Presence
traits.description: Hostile or opposing creatures who would make an ability check while they can see or hear you, suffer a 1d6 penalty to tha check as your presence alone makes it difficult for them to concentrate.

traits.name: Alien Existence
traits.description: You cannot be banished, teleported or moved against your will by any means.

traits.name: Crystal Release
traits.description: When you would deal Earth Damage, you may add your Charisma modifier to the damage dealt.

traits.name: Crystalline Stone
traits.description: Constructs and Structures you summon gain additional hit points equal to twice your level.

traits.name: Rock Hard
traits.description: While you are gaining the benefits of a Jutsu cast with the Earth Release keyword, you reduce incoming damage by 1d6+1

traits.name: Crystalized Focus
traits.description: Jutsu you cast with the Earth Release Keyword cannot have their concentration broken as a result of damage, if the damage dealt is less than half of its original value.

traits.name: Crystals are Forever
traits.description: Constructs and Structures you summon do not dissolve or vanish after their duration ends, instead solidifying and becoming a part of the terrain, permanently or until destroyed.

traits.name: Clan of Gods
traits.description: Makes Saving throws to resist Ninjutsu at Advantage, but rolling 3d20, taking the highest one.

traits.name: Life Force Fruit
traits.description: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP, their body is turned into a fruit. As an Action, by consuming the fruit, you regain Xd12 Hit points and Chakra, where X = Twice the creatures level.

traits.name: The Birth of Worlds
traits.description: When you fall to 50% hit points or reach reach a new phase of combat, you automatically cast Reality break targeting all hostile creatures within 250 feet of you.

traits.name: The End of Humanity
traits.description: By spending 200 Chakra or 15 Tenacity die, you can cast Medical Release: Genocide targeting all creatures within 250 feet of you ignoring level based restriction and the need to know their names.

traits.name: The Power of Absolution
traits.description: You are immune to All conditions inflicted by Ninjutsu and Genjutsu unless you are Bloodied (50% HP). This trait can be temporarily disabled if this adversary takes enough damage in a single instance. If this Adversary takes at least 150 Damage or 10% of its maximum hit points in a single instance of damage (whichever is higher) this trait is disabled until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Raw Chakra
traits.description: This adversary has a pool of Raw chakra equal. [Level*2]. This Chakra can be spent on any Jutsu. When it is spent on Jutsu in this way, increase the number of damage die a jutsu has by +1 for every 4 raw chakra spent, up to a max of +5 damage die.

traits.name: Savage Form
traits.description: This adversary can enter a save form, imbued and enhanced by Raw Nature Energy as a bonus action for the next minute. While in this form, this adversary makes all Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saving thows at advantage. These saving throws cannot be made at disadvantage. Additionally, melee damage dealt by this adversary while in this form, increases by 1 Step. Finally, this adversary gains the Berserk condition for the duration of this form.

traits.name: Thrusters and Jets
traits.description: This adversary can release jolts of chakra from its joints massively increasing its speed. This adversary gains a +[Level*10] Bonus to speed, rounded up to the nearest 5. They can also, spend a bonus action to burst forth up to their full movement towards another creature. This movement cannot provoke attack of opportunity.

traits.name: Measured Insanity
traits.description: This adversaries Intelligence and Wisdom is reduced to 5. But in exchange they become immune to Genjutsu that force an Intelligence or Wisdom saving throw. Additionally, they can no longer see any creature as an ally, only hostile.

traits.name: Unmeasured Rage
traits.description: This adversaries Charisma score is reduced to 5. But in exchange, they become immune to Genjutsu that force a Charisma saving throw, Fuinjutsu that would grapple, restrain or reduce their movement speed to 0, and they reduce all incoming damage by an amount equal to their level from all sources except Psychic, Chakra and Force.

traits.name: Bloody Recycling
traits.description: If there is a corpse within 30 feet of you, you can use this corpse twice as a sufficient source of water for jutsu. If you use this trait alongside the Sanguine Prowess trait, you can both benefits that the jutsu can receive for being near a sufficient source of water.

traits.name: Exploding Human Technique
traits.description: You learn the adversary exclusive hijutsu, Exploding Human Technique. This jutsu can be found on the Chinoike standalone document.

traits.name: Ichorous Defense
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can remove all ranks of bleeding from a creature within 60 feet. Additionally, when you cast a jutsu with the Water Release keyword, you can double the cost of the jutsu to gain temporary hit points equal to the jutsu's Save DC, and gain back a number of hit points equal to the damage dealt with the jutsu to a single target.

traits.name: Mental Medicine
