traits.description: When one or more allies within 60 feet of you would fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, you can use your reaction to allow them to automatically succeed, suffering no damage or effects. You can do this twice per encounter.

traits.name: Plasmaic Supercharge
traits.description: (Recharge 5-6) As an action, you can grant all allies within 30 feet a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls, +1 AC, +20 feet of movement speed, and an additional reaction. These effects last until the end of each of their turns

traits.name: Sanguine Prowess
traits.description: When you cast a jutsu with the Water Release keyword, you can as part of the same action release a small amount of blood, infusing it with the jutsu. The jutsu gains the benefits of being near a sufficient source of water, and gains a +1 to damage die, healing die, and Save DC. If the jutsu gains no benefits for being near a sufficient source of water, double these bonuses.

traits.name: Go With The Flow
traits.description: You are resistant to wind damage and you ignore half cover.

traits.name: Raging Tempest
traits.description: Jutsu with the Wind Release Keyword have their area of effect increased by 15 feet.

traits.name: Typhoon Release
traits.description: Increase all wind damage by 1 die step.

traits.name: Forceful Gale
traits.description: Your wind damage ignores resistance and when you deal wind damage you inflict 1 rank of bleed.

traits.name: Windborne
traits.description: You ignore difficult terrain and can take the Dash action as a bonus action. When you Dash, you automatically Disengage and gain flying speed equal to half your movement speed until the end of the turn as a gust of wind propels your movement.

traits.name: Slipstream
traits.description: Creatures cannot take reactions to your movement.

traits.name: Data Channels
traits.description: You gain a number of Data Channels of the Genwa Clan equal to your Intelligence modifier.

traits.name: Data Release
traits.description: Jutsu you cast with the Lightning Release keyword can deal force damage, and gain +1 to attack and damage rolls, Save DC, and increase their damage dealt by 1 step.

traits.name: Data Miner
traits.description:
Twice per combat, when you affect a creature with a jutsu with the Lightning Release keyword, you can do one of the following;
- Change any saving throw the jutsu imposes to target the saving throw the creature possesses with the lowest bonus.
- Reduce any number of uses they have of a class or clan feature by -2.
- Halve their proficiency bonus for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw they make before the end of your next turn. (you can choose when this happens.)

traits.name: Source Code
traits.description: Twice per combat, when you cast a jutsu with the Lightning Release keyword, you can cast a Genwa Hijutsu as part of the same action, at no cost.

traits.name: Stable Frequency
traits.description: All Sensory jutsu you possess gain the lightning release keyword. When you cast a jutsu with the Sensory and Lightning Release keyword, its duration automatically doubled and you have advantage on checks to maintain concentration.

traits.name: Medical Fist
traits.description: With Jutsu that deal your Unarmed Damage in any way, gain a +15ft bonus to range and deal double damage to structures, constructs, and objects.

traits.name: Combat Medicine
traits.description: When you cast a Taijutsu, Dash, Disengage, or Dodge, you can cast a Medical Jutsu that provides hit points, temporary hit points, damage reduction, or a boost or boon, that have a casting time of one Action as a bonus action. You can do this no more than once per round.

traits.name: Empowered Healing
traits.description: All Jutsu with the Medical keyword you cast on another allied creature(s) cause the creature to always gain the benefits of the Restorative Ninjutsu at B-Rank.

traits.name: Hardened Body, Hardened Mind
traits.description: Twice per encounter when you would be forced to make a saving throw you may convert the save into a Strength or Wisdom saving throw.

traits.name: Hanami Boons
traits.description: A number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per combat, use any of Hanami Boons listed within the Hanami clan (following the same restrictions for their use). Additionally, medical jutsu you cast increase the size of their healing die by 1 step.

traits.name: Star Chakra
traits.description: While engaged in combat this adversary's chakra is replaced by a secondary Pool of chakra Equal to [Level * 10], called Star Chakra. Star Chakra can be used to cast Jutsu of any type, and cannot be absorbed, damaged, or reduced by hostile effects. Jutsu cast with Star Chakra cannot be dispelled by hostile effects of a Rank equal to or less than the jutsu cast, and if it has the Clash keyword it gains a bonus to its clash checks equal to half the adversary's level.

traits.name: Cosmic Healer
traits.description: As an action it can spend 5 Star Chakra to heal 5d8 hit points and remove one condition from itself.

traits.name: Star Predation
traits.description: As an action, this adversary can attempt to absorb the chakra of a hostile creature. Make a ranged Ninjutsu or Genjutsu attack against a creature up to 90 feet away. On a hit, deal [Level]d6 chakra damage, and regain a number of chakra points equal to the damage dealt.

traits.name: Ashen Movement
traits.description: You are immune to knockback and up to two times per round, when you cast a jutsu with the Fire release keyword or deal Fire damage, you can move up to 15 in any direction as a gust of smoke, without provoking an attack of opportunity.

traits.name: Smoke Release
traits.description: Your Save DC for jutsu with the Fire Release keyword is increased by +2. When you deal fire damage, you can as a bonus action blind all affected creatures until the start of your next turn. Once you use this trait, you must spend 2 Tenacity to regain 1 spend use.

traits.name: Will-O-Wisp
traits.description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll that deals Fire damage, you can force each creature within 10 feet to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the damage the original target took on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

traits.name: Weaponized Fumes
traits.description: You can a special natural weapon known as Smoke Shot. This weapon has a range of (60/90), uses your Ninjutsu attack bonus and deals Xd6 Fire damage, where X is equal to half your Intelligence modifier, rounded up. You can use Smoke Shot in place of a Ranged weapon for any bukijutsu. Attacks with Smoke Shot count as an attack roll with a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword.

traits.name: Star Shower
traits.description: Fire or Lightning damage you deal ignores resistance and gains a +1 bonus to critical threat range. Additionally, once per combat, when you cast a jutsu with the Fire or Lightning keyword, you increase triple the range and create 3 copies of the jutsu targeting different areas. These jutsu deal a third as much damage and give out a third as much of any conditions (Min. 1).

traits.name: Light Creator
traits.description: When you would touch an object you may cause it to begin glowing a bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

traits.name: Energy Overflow
traits.description: Once per turn when you would deal fire damage you deal an additional amount of damage equal to your level.

traits.name: Burning Plasma
traits.description: Creatures that start their turn or enter spaces that are considered to be in bright light due to light you have created take 1d8 fire damage.

traits.name: Overcharge
traits.description: When you would break concentration on a jutsu with the fire release keyword, you may pay the chakra cost of the jutsu to stay concentrating on the jutsu.

traits.name: Weapon Formation
traits.description:
When you cast a Konjiki Hijutsu, you can choose to deal Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, or Earth damage, giving the jutsu the following effects;
- Bludgeoning: Trigger the damage bonus of the Bruised condition an additional time per turn, if target is Bruised. Give the target one rank of Bruised if you critically hit them or they critically fail their saving throw (Fail by -5 or more).
- Piercing: Ignore an amount of the target's DR equal to your proficiency bonus. Give the target one rank of Weakened if you critically hit them or they critically fail their saving throw (Fail by -5 or more).
- Slashing: Increase the range of the jutsu by +10ft, and any area of effects by 5 feet in all directions. Give the target one rank of Lacerated if you critically hit them or they critically fail their saving throw (Fail by -5 or more).
- Earth: Increase the damage of your jutsu by your proficiency bonus. Give the target the Dazed condition if you critically hit them or they critically fail their saving throw (Fail by -5 or more).

traits.name: Blood of the Earth
traits.description: Increase your AC by half your Intelligence modifier (Max. +3), and you may use Intelligence for weapon and Taijutsu attacks with weapons created with Steel that you wield.

traits.name: Perfected Creation
traits.description: Jutsu with the Earth Release keyword that create a construct gain a +1 bonus to AC, +5 damage reduction, and a +1d4 bonus to attack and damage rolls.

traits.name: Steel Release
traits.description: Increase the damage die and temporary hit point die of Konjiki Hijutsu by 1 step. Additionally, reduce the cost of Konjiki Hijutsu by -3.

traits.name: Reinforced and Pressurized
traits.description: When you cast a jutsu with the earth release keyword that creates a construct or gives Temporary Hit Points, the construct or the target creature gains an additional amount of Temp Hit Points or Hit Points equal to your Level.

traits.name: Potent Inner Chi
traits.description: All Taijutsu you cast gain a +2 to attack rolls, damage die, or Save DC (Pick one at casting).

traits.name: 72 Earthly Transformations
traits.description: Once per casting, jutsu you cast can benefit from one of the transformations options from the 72 Earthly Transformations clan feature.

traits.name: Monkey Paw
traits.description: You gain a bonus to Strength and Dexterity skill checks equal to a 1d8.

traits.name: Immortal Techniques
traits.description: Once per turn, when you would be reduced to 0 hitpoints, you can spend half of your current chakra and regain hp equal to twice your Taijutsu Save DC.

traits.name: Shi Hou Agility
traits.description: Increase your movement speed by 5 feet for every 2 levels you have and gain a climbing speed equal to your movement speed.

traits.name: Snake-Like
traits.description: You are able to speak to snakes and gain the Jutsu "Summoning Technique" allowing you to summon snakes.

traits.name: Power of Will
traits.description: Once per encounter you may convert any saving throw into a Charisma save.

traits.name: Empowered Immune System
traits.description: You gain immunity to poison damage and effects caused by poison damage.

traits.name: Orochimaru's Legacy
traits.description: Once per turn when you would do poison damage you deal an additional amount of damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Additionally, you ignore resistance to poison.

traits.name: Got You
traits.description: You may use Ninshou instead of athletics for grapple checks. Additionally, creatures you are grappling take 1d8 bludgeoning damage at the beginning of their turns.

traits.name: Genjutsu Resilience
traits.description: Advantage against Genjutsu with Auditory and Visual Keywords

traits.name: Immortality
traits.description: You cannot die from old age or succumb to effects that would artificially age you or instantly kill you. You are also immune to the Frightened condition, and at the end each round regain 10% of your maximum hit points unless you were critically hit during this round.

traits.name: Overpower Might
traits.description: You may impose disadvantage on a saving throw against a Genjutsu, Taijutsu, or Bukijutsu you cast. You may do this a number of times equal to 3 + the number of enemies you are facing per combat encounter.

traits.name: Tool of Darkness
traits.description: You learn either the Claw of Night and Tool of Night Hijutsu, and may activate these jutsu as a free action.

traits.name: Charming Persona
traits.description: You are immune to the Charmed condition, and hostile creatures suffer a -3 penalty on saving throws to resist the Charmed/Frightened conditions you inflict.

traits.name: Talented Blade
traits.description: You add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to your weapon damage.

traits.name: Balance of Emotion
traits.description: Select two Balance of Emotion options from the Yamada clan. You have a number of Balance die (d6) equal to your level.

traits.name: Sharpened Edge
traits.description: Your weapons' deal an extra die of damage.

traits.name: Single-Swing Style
traits.description: Once per turn, when you would score a critical hit you add additional damage die equal to half your level.

traits.name: A Single Strike
traits.description: Once per turn, when you cast a Bukijutsu with the finisher keyword you may spend 10 chakra to treat the jutsu as if it was cast as a finisher.

traits.name: Precise Fighter
traits.description: You gain a +1 to critical threat range. When you score a critical hit, you deal an additional amount of damage equal to Xd6, where X equals your proficiency bonus. This damage is NOT doubled from the critical hit. Additionally, you gain a +2 bonus to saving throws when you land a critical hit.

traits.name: Intelligent Attacks
traits.description: You gain a +1 to critical threat range. When you make a ranged weapon attack, you can choose to aim for a creatures Arm or Leg. If you aim for their Arm, on a hit you deal an additional 1d10 damage and the creature must make a Strength saving throw against your highest save DC, becoming unable to use their arm and unable to weave signs until the end of their next turn. If you aim for their Leg, on a hit you deal an additional 1d10 damage and the creature must makle a Constitution saving throw, halving their movement speed until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Best Sniper
traits.description: You have advantage on Stealth checks and the first ranged attack you make per round does not automatically reveal your location. Additionally, you can automatically determine the quality, seals, and if any magical abilities are present on an object you can see.

traits.name: Analytic Eye
traits.description: You gain a +1 to critical threat range and your critical threat range bonus now "applies" to saving throws you make against Genjutsu or Fuinjutsu. If you were to "score a critical" on a saving throw against a Genjutsu or Fuinjutsu, you automatically succeed the saving throw regardless of your results and suffer no damage or effects.

traits.name: Truest Sight
traits.description: You gain a +1 to critical threat range, and you ignore critical threat range limits. You ignore all effects that would hinder your sight and gain 30 feet of True Sight. Finally, your Evolved Eye is always active.

traits.name: Deadly Aim
traits.description: You gain advantage to all ranged Bukijutsu and weapon attacks made with a crossbow, and ignore any penalties imposed due to close or long range.

traits.name: Explosive Ammunition
traits.description: Once per round, when you damage a creature with a crossbow, you can make all creatures within 5 feet of the target must make a Dexterity saving throw against your highest Save DC. Success: Xd4 fire damage, where X equals your proficiency bonus. Failure: Half damage. This trait may activate twice per encounter.

traits.name: Fanning Mastery
traits.description: Whenever you take the Attack Action while using a Crossbow, Hand you may expend a full stack of Ammunition to make 6 weapon attacks.

traits.name: Lady Luck's Favorite
traits.description: Once per round, when you would roll a 1 or 2 on an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, you may choose to reroll until you roll above a 2.

traits.name: Lever-Action Savant
traits.description:
All Crossbows you wield lose the Loading weapon property and count as any weapon with the Ranged or Thrown weapon property to interact and qualify for Jutsu prerequisites and 
interactions.

traits.name: Pure Destruction
traits.description: When you would deal necrotic damage, you ignore resistance and treat immunity as resistance.

traits.name: Disintegrating Pressure
traits.description: While you are benfitting from a jutsu with the Lightning or Fire Release keywords, you increase the range of all jutsu with these keywords by 15 feet, and the area of effects by 5 feet.

traits.name: Destructive Aura
traits.description: All creatures and objects not being worn within 15 ft of you when you would cast a Hakaiton Hijutsu must make a Con saving throw against your Ninjutsu Save DC or take a Xd4 Necrotic damage on a failed save. (Where X equals your Prof. Bonus)

traits.name: Chain of Destruction
traits.description: When you would successfully land an attack with a jutsu that deals damage and has the Lightning Release keyword, you can spend 5 chakra to have the jutsu's energy jumps to another target within range of the jutsu. Each additional target must make a Dexterity saving throw against the DC of whichever jutsu type triggered this effect, taking half the damage of the original jutsu on a failed save. The number of additional targets is determined by your Int. Modifier.

traits.name: Festering Wound
traits.description: When you would deal necrotic damage the creature's maximum hit points are reduced by an amount equal to the damage dealt. If this reduces a creature's hit points to 0, they disintegrate, dissolving into nothing. The creatures maximum hp is restored to normal after a full rest or the jutsu restorative at B-rank or higher is casted on them.

traits.name: Forceful Will
traits.description: Once per turn when you would force a creature to make a saving throw, you can impose disadvantage.

traits.name: Manifested Power
traits.description: You ignore the HS component.

traits.name: Mental Superiority
traits.description: When you would make a saving throw that would inflict a Mental or Sensory condition, you gain a 1d6 bonus to the result.

traits.name: Pschoawareness
traits.description: You gain 30 feet of blindsight and you cannot be surprised.

traits.name: Iron Mind
traits.description: You gain resistance to psychic damage and you make genjutsu saving throws at advantage.

traits.name: Undefined Percent
traits.description: When your Kageyama Clan passive would activate, you gain the benefits of all bullet points of your respective percent feature.

traits.name: Sacrificial Power
traits.description: Your hit point and chakra pools are combined into one pool that can be used as chakra or hit points.

traits.name: Unwavering Hope
traits.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws and you cannot critically fail a Wisdom saving throw.

traits.name: Spirit Walk
traits.description: As a bonus action, or reaction when you would take damage, you can become ethereal, suspending all conditions on yourself and gaining resistance to necrotic, poison, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. You remain this way until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Soul Possession
traits.description: You can attempt to possess a creature as an action on your turn. The creature must make a Charisma saving throw against your highest Save DC or suffer the effects of the Soul Possession clan feature.

traits.name: Strength of Spirit
traits.description: You gain advantage on saving throws to resist Mental and Sensory conditions.

traits.name: Cloud Jumpers
traits.description: You reduce all damage you would take from falling by half. Additionally, your high jump height is inceased by an amount equal to your level X 5.

traits.name: Fog Formation
traits.description: When you would cast a Kozu Hijutsu you create a 10by10 ft cube fog within 30 feet of you. The fog lasts for 5 turns or or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it. Creatures inside this cloud of fog cannot see more than 5 feet away from them, gaining disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to see and Attacks made while inside the cloud of fog that rely on sight. Creatures outside the fog also have disadvantage when attacking other creatures who are inside the mist.

traits.name: High Minded
traits.description: Lightning damage you deal ignores resistance and treats immunity as resistance

traits.name: Chlling Wind
traits.description: Cold damage you deal ignores resistance and treats immunity as resistance

traits.name: Could Cover
traits.description: As a bonus action, you may completely shroud a willing creature with a medium sized cloud if that creature is within 15 feet of you. The Creature shrouded by the cloud is counted as having half cover for a number of rounds equal to half your prof. bonus rounded up.

traits.name: Boosters
traits.description: You gain a flying speed equal to your base movement speed. Additionally, while you are in the air your AC is increased by 1.

traits.name: Defensive Aura
traits.description: You begin all combats with double your level Temporary Hp.

traits.name: Constructed Being
traits.description: You have resistance to poison and advantage on Constitution saving throws.

traits.name: Floating Array
traits.description: You can simultaneously wield a number of light weapons in your Floating Array equal to your proficiency bonus. You may use Intelligence instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls made with these weapons. You can make a number of attacks a turn equal to the number of weapons you have in your floating array. Additionally, all weapons in your floating array gain Reach (2).

traits.name: 1s and 0s
traits.description: You can cast all Bukijutsu using your Intelligence Mod.

traits.name: Limitless Barrier
traits.description: When you would make a Dexterity saving throw, you can spend 5 chakra to change the saving throw to a Constitution saving throw. If this would allow you to succeed, you can then immediately use your reaction to suffer no damage or effects that would come with passing the saving throw, and you can cast a Mugen Clan Hijutsu with a casting time 1 reaction.
traits.categories: Attack, Defence, Control, Mobility Utility, Buff

traits.name: Spectrum
traits.description: Mugen Hijutsu you cast without the Red Keyword, increase their Save DC by 2. Mugen Hijutsu you cast without the Blue Keyword, add your proficiency bonus to damage rolls.

traits.name: Boundless
traits.description: You gain resistance to force damage and cannot be moved against your will. Additionally, when you move you can instead teleport.

traits.name: Cosmic Abyss
traits.description: When you cast a Mugen Hijutsu with the Red or Blue keyword, you may as a bonus action cast a Mugen Hijutsu with a casting time of 1 action or bonus action. The second Hijutsu must have the opposite color keyword. Additionally, you may as a reaction attempt to make a jutsu affecting you disperse into the void as if you cast Chakra Shatter. You roll at advantage using Chakra Shatter this way and can do so twice per combat.
traits.categories: Attack, Defence, Control, Mobility Utility, Buff

traits.name: Infinity
traits.description: When you cast a jutsu, you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus until the end of your next turn. This can stack up to two times per turn. If the jutsu cast is a Mugen Hijutsu, double the amount gained.

traits.name: Feline Stature
traits.description: The adversary counts as both a humanoid and beast, and can communicate with any feline creature.

traits.name: Feline Nature
traits.description: The adversary gains any & all abilities under the Ninneko clan's Feline Nature feature.

traits.name: Nine Lives
traits.description: Once per combat, when this adversary is reduced to 0 hit points, it is instead reduced to 1 hit point and can move up to half its speed.

traits.name: Feline Sense
traits.description: The adversary has expertise in Perception and adds its level to all checks made with this skill having to do with smell or sound. It also has chakra sight with these senses to a range of 60 ft.

traits.name: Zoomies
traits.description: When the adversary moves on its turn, it can double its speed until the end of the turn. Once it uses this trait, it can't use it again until it moves 0 feet on one of its turns. Opportunity attacks against it as a result of this movement are made with disadvantage. The adversary can sacrifice this extra movement to instead pounce a creature within 5 feet of it, forcing the target to succeed a Strength save or become restrained.

traits.name: Snake-Like
traits.description: You are able to speak to snakes and gain the Jutsu "Summoning Technique" allowing you to summon snakes.

traits.name: Power of Will
traits.description: Once per encounter you may convert any saving throw into a Charisma save.

traits.name: Empowered Immune System
traits.description: You gain immunity to poison damage and effects caused by poison damage.

traits.name: Orochimaru's Legacy
traits.description: Once per turn when you would do poison damage you deal an additional amount of damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Additionally, you ignore resistance to poison.

traits.name: Got You
traits.description: You may use Ninshou instead of athletics for grapple checks. Additionally, creatures you are grappling take 1d8 bludgeoning damage at the beginning of their turns.

traits.name: Far Sight
traits.description: You have the ability to create visual points of origin as a bonus action. You may use your bonus action to create a visual point of origin up to 90 ft away from you and you may have up to 2 visual points of origin at a single time. You are able to cast just treating their point of origin as the visual point of origin.

traits.name: 20-20 Vision
traits.description: Your Passive Perception is increased by 5, and if a creature teleports out of your reach, they still provoke an opportunity attack from you.

traits.name: Perfect Sight
traits.description: You ignore the Mobility component and gain true sight up to 30 ft.

traits.name: Final Perception
traits.description: When you would reach 0 hp, you grant the following benefits to a creature you can see; they gain any 2 jutsu you know, they gain any 2 of your features, and they gain an amount of Temp Hp and Temp Cp equal to half of your remaining Cp and all of your memories

traits.name: Distant Vision
traits.description: Double the range of all ranged attacks.

traits.name: Perfected Vision
traits.description: You are immune to the blinded condition and have advantage against genjutsu with the Visual keyword.

traits.name: Numerical Vision (Recharge 7-8)
traits.description: You can decide if a creature within 60 feet of you has succeeded on their attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, or failed.

traits.name: Bankai
traits.description: You must have the Shikai trait to gain this feature. As a bonus action, you can spend 20 chakra to awaken your Zanpakuto into its final form, the Bankai. While in this form, it gains the benefits from being in its Shikai form, gains an additional 2 weapon properties, and deals an additional die of damage. Your proficiency bonus also increases by 1.

traits.name: Death's Chosen
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can give yourself 60 feet of true sight for 10 minutes. While this is active, creatures below your level that enter or begin their turn within 20 feet of you become weakened and take an additional die of damage, whenever you deal damage to them.

traits.name: Mastered Body
traits.description: Shinigami Ninjutsu you cast that require an attack roll always add your Zanpakuto's weapon damage to damage rolls. Additionally, jutsu that boost your AC or give temporary hit points, give +1 more AC or 2 extra dice of thp for the duration.

traits.name: Mastered Mind
traits.description: Your movement speed is increased by 15 feet and when when you hit with at least two attacks with your Zanpakuto, you gain the benefits of either the Dash or Disengage actions until the end of the current turn.

traits.name: Shikai
traits.description: On your turn, you can spend 5 chakra to awaken your Zanpakuto into its second form, the Shikai. When you do, your weapon gains 2 new weapon properties, which are able to stack with one another. Your weapon damage also increases by 1 die and by 1 die step.

traits.name: Cunning Genjutsu
traits.description: You may use Intelligence in place of Wisdom for the attack and damage rolls and Save DC's of Tayuya Hijutsu you cast.

traits.name: Precise Performance
traits.description: Increase your genjutsu attack bonus by 3.

traits.name: Potent Genjutsu
traits.description: Twice per encounter you can make a genjutsu you cast deal the maximum damage.

traits.name: Disorientating Genjutsu
traits.description: Auditory Genjutsu you cast impose a rank of disorientation on failed save.

traits.name: Phantasia Blessing
traits.description: Increase your genjutsu critical threat range by 3.

traits.name: Maximum Volume
traits.description: Genjutsu with the auditory keyword have their range or area of effect doubled.

traits.name: Healing Mastery
traits.description: Whenever you would regain hit points, you instead regain double the amount of hit points you would normally receive.

traits.name: Intense Chakra
traits.description: Twice per encounter you may convert any saving throw you would make into a Constitution saving throw.

traits.name: Sturdy Body
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws to resist the following conditions. Blinded, Deafened, Dazed, Poisoned, Envenomed, Paralyzed, Weakened

traits.name: Genius Inventor
traits.description: You have invented a large deal of jutsu. Increase your amount of selected jutsu by 10

traits.name: Chakra Pressure
traits.description: Twice per encounter, you may use your action to flex your chakra. All creatures within 30 ft of you must make a Wisdom Saving throw against your Ninjutsu Save DC or gain 2 ranks of fear

traits.name: Born to Battle
traits.description: When you make an attack roll, you can add a 1d4 to the result, and to the attack's damage roll. If you are an Elite adversary, you instead roll a 1d4+1. If you are a solo, for each phase transition you enter after the first, increase the 1d4 by 1 step. You can use this trait up to two times per turn.

traits.name: Determined to Fight
traits.description: When you would gain a condition from a hostile source, you can roll a 1d6. On a roll of 4 or higher, you automatically remove all ranks of the condition. You can remove one condition this way per round. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier per combat. If you are an Elite adversary, you roll a 1d6+1. If you enter a phase transition, decrease the number you must match or exceed by 1 for each phase transition after the 1st.

traits.name: Latent Zenkai
traits.description:
When you first fall to 0 hit points, you instead fall to 1 hit point, gain temporary hit points and temporary chakra equal to twice your level, and immediately cast a jutsu that would improve your abilities with the range of self that does not affect a hostile creature, ignoring the listed casting time. This can activate once per
full rest.

traits.name: Monkey See, Monkey Do
traits.description: As a reaction, when a creature casts a jutsu within 30 feet of you, you can add the jutsu to your jutsu known list, ignoring ability score requirements. As part of the same reaction, you can cast that same jutsu at the creature, using their ability scores unless yours are higher. You can do this once per combat.

traits.name: Stubborn Target
traits.description: Once per round, you can increase your AC by 1d4 until the end of the turn. If you are an Elite or Solo adversary, you instead increase your AC by 1d4+1. You can use this trait three times per combat. If you enter a phase transition, you regain two uses of this trait.

traits.name: Name
traits.description: Description

traits.name: Cursed Seal
traits.description: You have [Max Chakra/2] Cursed Chakra.

traits.name: Corrupted Arts
traits.description: All jutsu you cast gains 3 Corrupted boosts from the Cursed Seal Class Mod. These 3 boosts are applied to all jutsu you cast even if they normally cannot be.

traits.name: Corrupted Mind
traits.description: Your mind is twisted by your cursed chakra. You have a +2 bonus to Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws. Also, creatures cannot read your mind or control it by any means.

traits.name: Corrupted Body
traits.description: Your body is twisted by your cursed chakra. You have a +2 bonus to Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Also, conditions inflicted upon you as a result of a jutsu immediately ends at the beginning of each of your turns.

traits.name: Corrupted Soul
traits.description: Your soul is twisted by your cursed chakra. You have a +2 bonus to Constitution and Charisma saving throws. Also, creatures who target you or who would affect you with fuinjutsu makes their ability checks or attack rolls using said fuinjutsu at disadvantage.

traits.name: Cursed Seal, Stage 1
traits.description: Your body is covered by black markings. While in this stage, you gain a +2 to all ability scores and you gain 2 Tenacity die that are d6's.

traits.name: Cursed Seal, Stage 2
traits.description: Your body turns darker as the cursed seal twists and morphs your physical features. While in this stage, you gain a +2 to all ability scores, you gain 4 Tenacity die that are d6's, and you gain one form of special movement such as flight, swimming or burrowing, equal to your movement speed.

traits.name: Cursed Seal, Stage 3
traits.description: Your body turns darker as the cursed seal twists and morphs your physical features. While in this stage, you gain a +4 to all ability scores, you gain 6 Tenacity die that are d6's, and you gain one form of special movement such as flight, swimming or burrowing, equal to your movement speed, and you select 2 Jutsu that you know. You can cast these jutsu at 0 Chakra cost.

traits.name: Dark Release
traits.description: This Adversary has [Level x 10] Dark Chakra.

traits.name: Bane of Light
traits.description: When you cast a dark art, gain a +1 bonus to saving throws for each creature affected by the triggering dark art.

traits.name: Chimera Technique
traits.description: As an action, select one  creature. Target makes a Wisdom Saving throw vs your Ninjutsu Save DC, On a failed save, you steal one feature, jutsu or reduce one of their ability scores by -4 for 1d4 of your turns. You gain the stolen feature, jutsu or reduced ability score for the same duration.

traits.name: Dark Bribe
traits.description: As a reaction, when a creature would cast a jutsu or Art that would affect you, you may spend a number of Dark chakra equal to twice the chakra cost of the jutsu or art they cast, negating it. You then gain one use of the stolen Jutsu or Art, as if you met all prerequisites needed to cast it.

traits.name: Dark Chakra Cloak
traits.description: As a bonus action, spend 20 Dark Chakra materializing a cloak of chakra. All creatures within 60 feet of you, increases their chakra cost for jutsu, Arts and features by 5. You reduce the cost of your Jutsu, Arts and features by 5.

traits.name: The Darkness
traits.description: Creatures who fail a saving throw against you reduces the failed saving throw bonus by -1 for 1d4 of your turns. If the same saving throw is reduced again, the duration is extended by 1d4.

traits.name: The Taker
traits.description: Creatures who fall to 0 hit points within 30 feet of you, are consumed by your Dark Release, turning into fuel for your desires. You gain access to a random selection of 3 features and 3 jutsu they knew in life.

traits.name: Whats yours is mine
traits.description: When a hostile creature within 30 feet of you, would regain hit points or chakra points you instead regain the recovered amount, and they regain 0.

traits.name: Light Release
traits.description: You have an amount of Light Chakra equal to 10 times your level.

traits.name: Bane of Dark
traits.description: When you cast a light art, all allies within 30 feet of you gain a +1 bonus to their saving throws until the end of your next turn. If they would gain this or The Lights benefit a second time befor the end of that specified turn, the duration is extended until the end of your following turn.

traits.name: Duality
traits.description: Creatures you are bonded with can  share their power with you. Bonded creatures can spend their action sharing their power with you, granting you a bonus to your next attack roll, damage roll, or save DC. (Pick two). Each time a bonded creature shares their power with you, roll 2d8 recording the result. When you choose to use the power they gave you, take the total of all d8's rolled as a result of this feature. If you apply this bonus to attack rolls, add half the result to the next attack roll, if your attacks result is 10 or higher than your targets AC, you treat it as a critical hit. If you apply this bonus to Damage, you deal additional damage equal to the result. If you apply the bonus to Save DC's increase your save DC's by one-third the result until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Light Chakra Cloak
traits.description: As a bonus action, spend 20 Light Chakra materializing a cloak of chakra. All allied creatures within 60 feet of you, reduce their chakra cost for jutsu by 5. Allied creatures also add one additional damage die to damage rolls.

traits.name: Light Gift
traits.description: As an action, you can select one allied creature. That creature gains the benefit of Light chakra cloak. If a creature would be within the radius of two or more creatures with the light chakra cloak, they only gain its bonuses once.

traits.name: The Giver
traits.description: Allied creatures who fall to 0 hit points within 60 feet of you, are marked by you. At the beginning of their next turn, they regain 10 hit points being revived. Each creature marked this way costs you 5Light Chakra.

traits.name: The Light
traits.description: Allied creatures who fail saving throws within 30 feet of you, gain a +1 bonus to their saving throws until the end of your next turn. If they would gain this or Bane of Darks benefit before the end of that speficied turn, the duration is extended until the end of your following turn

traits.name: Whats mine is yours
traits.description: When you would regain hit points or chakra points, all allied creatures within 30 feet of you gains half of your regained hit points or chakra points.

traits.name: Mangekyou Sharingan
traits.description: You have a Burn limit equal to twice your level.  Mangekyou Arts you cast do not cost Chakra to cast, only burn. If you spend more burn than your burn limit, for each additional burn you gain, you take 3d8 Necrotic Damage which cannot be reduced or resisted by any means. Additionally, you gain a +2 bonus to AC.

traits.name: Instinctual Sharingan
traits.description: You can select 2 additional Uchiha Clan Traits.

traits.name: Susanoo: Partial Manifestation
traits.description: You spend 5 burn to manifest your Susanoo's ribcage and both its arms for 1 minute. While manifested, you gain 50 susanoo hit points. You can also spend your action to make a manifested weapon attack using your highest attack bonus. If a melee attack it has a range of 15 feet, if ranged, it has a ranged of 120 feet. On a hit regardless, it deals 5d8+ your Constitution modifier in force damage.

traits.name: Susanoo: Half-Body Manifestation
traits.description: You spend 10 burn to manifest your Susanoo's upper-body, starting at the waist, up to its head for 1 minute. While manifested, you gain 100 susanoo hit points. You can also spend your action to make 2 manifested weapon attack using your highest attack bonus. If a melee attack it has a range of 15 feet, if ranged, it has a ranged of 120 feet. On a hit regardless, it deals 6d8+ your Constitution modifier in force damage.

traits.name: Susanoo: Full-Body Manifestation
traits.description: You spend 15 burn to manifest your Susanoo's full-body for 1 minute. While manifested, you gain 150 susanoo hit points. You can also spend your action to make a 3 manifested weapon attacks using your highest attack bonus. If a melee attack it has a range of 15 feet, if ranged, it has a ranged of 120 feet. On a hit regardless, it deals 7d8+ your Constitution modifier in force damage. You gain a fly speed equal to twice your speed.

traits.name: Sharingan Dodge 4
traits.description: You spend a reaction and 3 burn to instantly dodge any attack, jutsu or Art, regardless if it is an area effect or requires a saving throw. You dodge it.

traits.name: Ultimate Uchiha
traits.description: You reduce the burn cost of all Arts and Traits you use by 2, to a minimum of 1.

traits.name: Eternal Mangekyou Sharingan
traits.description: You instead have a Burn limit of 10 times your level.  Also, If you spend more burn than your burn limit, for each additional burn you gain, you take 1d8 Necrotic Damage which cannot be reduced or resisted by any means. Additionally, you instead gain a +4 bonus to AC.

traits.name: Rinnegan
traits.description: You have a Divine Fatigue limit equal to twice your level.  Creation, Destruction and Outer Arts you cast do not cost Chakra to cast. Instead they give you a number of Divine Fatigue equal to the number of chakra die they would cost. If you spend more Divine Fatigue than your fatigue limit, for each additional fatigue you gain, you gain 1 rank of weakened which cannot be removed until you complete a long rest.

traits.name: Outer Arts
traits.description: You gain 1 Outer Path Art of your choice. You have the following Statistics; Art Save DC: 12 + 1/4th your level + your proficiency bonus / Art Attack Bonus: 1/4th your level + twice your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Destruction Arts
traits.description: You gain 3 Destruction Arts of your choice. You have the following Statistics; Art Save DC: 12 + 1/4th your level + your proficiency bonus / Art Attack Bonus: 1/4th your level + twice your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Creation Arts
traits.description: You gain 3 Creation Arts of your choice. You have the following Statistics; Art Save DC: 12 + 1/4th your level + your proficiency bonus / Art Attack Bonus: 1/4th your level + twice your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Paths of Creation
traits.description: You have 3 Additional bodies. Each body has one of the 4 body types listed in the Paths of Creation and Destruction section in the Rinnegan Class Mod. Each body gains access to one Creation Art you can cast.

traits.name: Paths of Destruction
traits.description: You have 3 Additional bodies. Each body has one of the 4 body types listed in the Paths of Creation and Destruction section in the Rinnegan Class Mod. Each body gains access to one Destruction Art you can cast.

traits.name: Gods Law
traits.description: You have an increased Divine Fatigue limit, equal to 3 times your level.

traits.name: Adjudication of God
traits.description: When you or a body you control would be reduced to 0 Hit points, you or the body can spend a reaction. If you do, you or it immediately gain an additional turn, interrupting the current turn. If you or the body ends this turn with 0 hit points, it dies.

traits.name: Sage Mode
traits.description: You have an amount of Sage Chakra equal to 5 times your level. When you spend Sage Chakra you treat each Sage chakra spent as 2 normal chakra.

traits.name: Sage Affinity
traits.description: Select a Sage Affinity from the Sage Mode Class mod. You gain access to all of its features.

traits.name: Sage Proficiency
traits.description: You gain proficiency in all saving throws.

traits.name: Sage Passives
traits.description: Select 2 Sage Art: Passives. You gain them in addition to any you already have.

traits.name: Adept Sage Mode
traits.description: You gain additional Sage Chakra equal to two times your level. You now treat each Sage chakra spent as 3 normal chakra.

traits.name: Sage Art Mastery
traits.description: Sage Art: Techniques you cast, do  not harm your allies.

traits.name: Sage Abilities
traits.description: Select 2 Sage Art: Abilities. You gain them in addition to any you already have.

traits.name: Mastered Sage Mode
traits.description: You gain additional Sage Chakra equal to five times your level. You now treat each Sage chakra spent as 5 normal chakra.

traits.name: Sealed Beast
traits.description: You have an amount of Twisted Chakra equal to 25 times your level.

traits.name: Dormant Beast
traits.description: You can tap into the dormant powers of your Sealed beast. Your unarmed damage die is increased by 1 step and your STR and DEX are increased by +4

traits.name: Desperate Rage
traits.description: When you would fall to 25% or less hit points, or would enter your final Transition if you are a Solo, you gain 200 Temporary Hit points and enter the highest Twisted Cloak Stage possible early. You do not gain any additional Temporary hit points when you enter your Twisted Cloak as a result of this trait.

traits.name: Twisted Cloak, Stage 1
traits.description: As a bonus action, you gain 75 temporary Hit points. You gain a Claw attack that deals 2d8 + your level in one damage type of your choice. You can make this claw attack a number of times equal to 1/5th your level. You gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws.

traits.name: Twisted Cloak, Stage 2
traits.description: As a bonus action, you gain 125 temporary Hit points. You gain a Claw attack that deals 2d10 + your level in one damage type of your choice. You can make this claw attack a number of times equal to 1/5th your level. You gain a +2 bonus to all saving throws.

traits.name: Twisted Cloak, Stage 3
traits.description: As a bonus action, you gain 175 temporary Hit points. You gain a Claw attack that deals 2d12 + your level in one damage type of your choice. You can make this claw attack a number of times equal to 1/5th your level. You gain a +3 bonus to all saving throws.

traits.name: Twisted Cloak, Stage 4
traits.description: As a bonus action, you gain 250 temporary Hit points. You gain a Claw attack that deals 2d12 + your level in one damage type of your choice. You can make this claw attack a number of times equal to 1/5th your level. You gain a +4 bonus to all saving throws.

traits.name: Twisted Cloak, Stage 5
traits.description: As a bonus action, you gain 300 temporary Hit points. You gain a Claw attack that deals 3d12 + your level in one damage type of your choice. You can make this claw attack a number of times equal to 1/5th your level. You gain a +5 bonus to all saving throws. Your size becomes huge.

traits.name: Tenseigan
traits.description: You have an amount of Celestial Chakra equal to your Chakra. You also gain Perfect Vision up to 120 feet.

traits.name: Celestial Chakra Mode, Stage 1
traits.description: As a bonus action, you spend 20 Celestial Chakra. Your body is cloaked in celestial chakra. Your Strength, Dexterity and Wisdom Ability scores modifiers become +7 if they aren't already. If they are already +7 or greater. They increase by +1.

traits.name: Reincarnation Eye
traits.description: If you would be reduced to 0 Hit points. Your body is destroyed and reformed. You awake with 50% of your maximum Hit points and chakra points. You can only use this trait once, ever.

traits.name: Celestial Truth Orbs
traits.description: You gain 6 Celestial Truth orbs. You can spend these orbs according to the Celestial Truth Orbs Class mod feature.

traits.name: Cosmic Focus
traits.description: You can spend 50 Celestial Chakra. When you do you gain immunity to all Genjutsu until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Celestial Empowerment
traits.description: You can spend 50 Celestial Chakra. When you do, all Celestial Arts you cast have a +3 bonus to their critical threat range until te end of your next turn.

traits.name: Cosmic Backlash
traits.description: When a creature would deal enough damage to trigger a phase change for you. They take force damage equal to the amount of damage that triggered your phase change. This damage cannot reduce a creature below 1 hit point.

traits.name: Celestial Oversight
traits.description: Creature cannot teleport while within 30 feet of you. They also cannot be summoned while within this radius.

traits.name: Celestial Chakra Mode, Stage 2
traits.description: As a bonus action, you spend 100 Celestial Chakra. Your body is cloaked in celestial chakra. Your Strength, Dexterity and Wisdom Ability scores modifiers become +9 if they aren't already. If they are already +9 or greater. They increase by +1. Your speed is doubled and you gain a flying speed.

traits.name: Trait Name
traits.description: Description

traits.name: Passionate Flame
traits.description: While engaged with a creature whom the Land of Fire or the Leaf village considers a hostile entity, you gain temporary chakra equal to two and a half times your level in a rush of passion to defeat your villages enemies.

traits.name: Never Ending Drive
traits.description: If your chakra would fall to 0, you can still cast jutsu, activate traits and features. When you do, convert your hit points into chakra, at a rate of 2 Hit points to 1 Chakra point.

traits.name: Burning Loyalty
traits.description: While within 90 feet of an allied creature that you can see or hear, you gain a 2d4 bonus to resist jutsu and effects that would cause you to betray them in any way. If you would fail a saving throw or ability check to resist such an effect, you remake the save or ability check with a 2d4 bonus at the end of each of your turns, while actively doing things to betray your allies.

traits.name: Leaf Legacy
traits.description: Inspired by previous iconic leaf shinobi, you aspire to stand in their shadows. While in combat with a hostile creature who is at least 1 level higher than this adversary, they gain a number of d4s of a special resource called Legacy die equal to your level which resets per combat. These die can be spent to increase your attack or damage rolls by the result.

traits.name: The King
traits.description: While this adversary is in combat with an allied creature who is of a Rank or level lower that its own, this adversary gain a bonus to its attack, damage and Charisma based ability results equal to +2, in an attempt to help protect and guide their weaker allies.

traits.name: Fatal Wind
traits.description: While engaged with a creature whom the land of Wind or the Sand Village considers a hostile entity, the first instance of damage inflicted this combat deals bonus wind damage equal to [Half level x Prof].

traits.name: Sands of Fate
traits.description: The first two times you would fall to 0 hit points while in the land of wind, you instead fall to 1 hit point and gain 1 Reaction.

traits.name: Grains of Focus
traits.description: While within 90 feet of an allied creature that you can see or hear that is from the same village or country as you, Jutsu that requires concentration, cannot be ended as a result of damage.

traits.name: Gritty Survivalist
traits.description: Immunity to Hostile environments and difficult terrain.

traits.name: Desert Ruthlessness
traits.description: The first time you would reduce a creatures hit points to 0, while in the land of wind, they automatically fail 1 death saving throws.

traits.name: Rock Solid Ambition
traits.description: While engaged with a creature whom the land of Earth or the Earth Village considers a hostile entity, the first construct or structure you summon gains bonus Hit points equal to [Half level x Prof].

traits.name: Akuta Enhanced
traits.description: You have the blood of the 3rd Tsuchikage runnig through your veins although you are technically artificial. You cannot be controled, compelled, charmed or freightened by any creature other than your Captain or Kage.

traits.name: Fabrication of Stone
traits.description: You always count as a Construct for the purpose of jutsu that interacts with such. Additionally, you have resistance to Cold, Immunity to Earth, and Vulnerability to Lightning Damage.

traits.name: Stone Breaker
traits.description: Whenever you would initiate a clash with a jutsu you cast with the Earth Release Keyword against another creatures jutsu, you add 1d10 to the result of your check. On a success, double the damage dealt, if any.

traits.name: Symbol of Substance
traits.description: When you would gain Temporary hit points, double the value you gain. (Recharge 5-6)

traits.name: Thunderous Drive
traits.description: While engaged with a creature whom the land of Lightning or the Cloud Village considers a hostile entity, the first attack you make after taking damage, on each of your turns, gains a +1 critical threat range bonus.

traits.name: Shock and Awe
traits.description: You and another allied creature who begins combat with the same hostile enemy, that shares this trait, becomes a tag team duo. As a reaction, either holders of this trait can gain a movement and action at the end of the others turn.

traits.name: A, B, C's of Defeat
traits.description: You and another allied creature who begins combat with the same hostile enemy, that shares this trait, becomes a tag team duo. When one deals damage to a hostile creature, the other gains a bonus in damage equal to the other's level, against the same creature.

traits.name: Yo, Yo, Yo, My NINJA!
traits.description: You and another allied creature who begins combat with the same hostile enemy, that shares this trait, becomes a tag team duo. When one of this traits tag team duo's take damage, they can share in their allies misfortunes, reducing the damage they take by half, and taking the same amount of damage reduced. This damage reduction can only happen once per turn.

traits.name: Rappity, Rap, Tag Team Attack
traits.description: You and another allied creature who begins combat with the same hostile enemy, that shares this trait, becomes a tag team duo. As a full turn action, taken on each tag team duo's turn in the same round, both simultaneously cast a Jutsu with the Combination Keyword at the beginning of the following round, regardless of the initiative count. This jutsu's casting cannot be reacted to and deals bonus damage equal to the casters combined level. (Recharge 5-6)

traits.name: Mistchivious Gambit
traits.description: While engaged with a creature whom the land of Water or the Mist Village considers a hostile entity, the first time you would attempt a stealth check, you gain a bonus to the result equal to your level. Additionally, the first time you would strike a creature from stealth, using an attack, the attack is treated as a critical hit.

traits.name: Puff of Smoke
traits.description: While near a sufficient source of water you can, as a reaction to being targeting with an attack, or seeing a hostile creature move within 30 feet of them, cast the Water Release: Hidden Mist ninjutsu. Its duration is until the end of their next turn if cast in this way, and costs 15 Chakra.

traits.name: Demonic Mist
traits.description: When a jutsu is cast that would attempt to obscure or hide a hostile creature, as a reaction, you can mist mark them for the next minute. While Mist marked in this way, a creature cannot gain the benefits of being hidden from you and you are always aware of their location. A creature can remove the Mist mark by making a Dexterity (Stealth) check vs your Passive Perception +10. On a success, the mist mark is removed, and cannot be applied to them for 24 hours.

traits.name: Home Turf Advantage
traits.description: While you are within the Land of Water, you cannot be tracked, traced, or seen with Chakra Sight from a creature of equal level or lower than it or Sensory Jutsu cast of B-Rank or Lower.

traits.name: Seven Swordsman
traits.description: You have access to an iconic sword. Either one of ancient legend or one of recent fame. This sword is bound to it, and upon its death, it is banished back to the Mist Village to inform its Mizukage of the wielders Demise. This weapon is a +2 Odachi, that uses the highest abililty score of the wielder as its ability score required to wield, and calculate attack and damage rolls, it also has one Jutsu of C-Rank or Lower Sealed into it. This jutsu can be cast from the sword as a Bonus action, regardless of its normal casting time, and costs one of its seven charges.

traits.name: Poisonous Grass
traits.description: While engaged with a creature whom the land of Weeds or the Grass Village considers a hostile entity, the creatures whom you inflict with the envenomed condition, have its duration increased to 1 Day.

traits.name: Unreadable
traits.description: Hostile creatures cannot gain information about you. They cannot learn your Traits, resistances, hit point totals, they cannot recognize jutsu that you would cast, and cannot tell how injured you are, if at all. Additionally, you are immune to effects that would cause you to expose anything your Country or village considers a secret, you would sooner die than expose it.

traits.name: Diplomatic Interferance
traits.description: Hostile creatures have disadvantage when attempting to see through your deceptions, resist your diplomacies, or even find faults in your logic. When you would attempt to make a Charisma based check in an attempt to dissuade, convince or decieve a creature who is not from your country, gain a bonus to your checks equal to your level.

traits.name: Knowledge is Power
traits.description: Hostile creatures who would roll initiative and have a result that is lower than yours automatically reveal their ability scores, in addition to their class and nature release to this adversary. If a creature doesn't have a nature release, then you instead learn what category of jutsu the creature knows more of.

traits.name: Blood Prison Guard
traits.description: Hostile creatures who would be considered criminals to the Land of Weeds or the Grass Village, begin combat with a Blood Prison mark. Each time you deal damage to the hostile creature, they gain another mark, once per turn. If a creature has 5 or more marks on them, the Blood Prison Seal appears. This seal is treated as if the hostile creature was the target of the Uzumaki Art: River Dam Seal, regardless of their current condition. The DC to resist this casting is your Ninjutsu Save DC. Regardless of a pass or fail, a creature is cleansed of all Blood Prison Marks.

traits.name: Sound Divide
traits.description: While engaged in combat with a creature whom the land of Rice Paddies or the Sound Village considers a hostile entity, while that hostile creature is not within 30 feet of their allies, but within 30 feet of your allies, reduce the hostile creature's AC by -2, and their saving throw bonuses by -1.

traits.name: Birth of Power
traits.description: You were born for one reason, and one reason alone. To fuel the Otokage's drive for knowledge and power. The first time you would be reduced to 0 hit points, your hit points are restored back to 50%, and they gain the Cursed Seal class mod, but with only the Cursed seal, Stage 1 Trait.

traits.name: Sound-Tech
traits.description: You select one weapon it has or two of its attacking ligaments (Hands or feet). It becomes augmented with Sound Tech. While augmented in this way, it gain 5 charges. These charges can be spent to imitate any one Hijutsu of a rank it can cast, of its choice. Once this jutsu is chosen, it cannot be changed. When casting said jutsu, it spends one charge, but does not cost chakra.
traits.categories: Attack, Defence, Control, Mobility, Utility, Buff

traits.name: Test Subject (Mental)
traits.description: You have gone through a series of tests to enhance your mental capabilities. You can concentrait on up to 4 Jutsu at once. If you would concentrate on 4 jutsu at any one time, at the conclcusion of your concentration, you gain the Dazed condition for 24 hours.

traits.name: Test Subject (Physical)
traits.description: You have gone through a series of tests to enhance your physical capabilities. One jutsu you know becomes Sound Enhanced. While this jutsu is Sound enhanced, it can be cast at no cost, twice per encounter at 1 rank higher than you can currently cast. Each time this jutsu is cast in this way, the user gains 1 rank of weakened for the next hour.
traits.categories: Attack, Defence, Control, Mobility, Utility, Buff

traits.name: Waterfall Elite
traits.description: While engaged in combat with a creature whom the Land of Hills or the Waterfall Village considers a hostile entity, you rise to the challenge. You fall under the effects of the Bless Jutsu cast at D-Rank, for the first 1d4 rounds of combat.

traits.name: Prideful Gaze
traits.description: The Pride of the Waterfall Village fills your body. This pride infects those round it. All hostile creatures within 60 feet of you who would roll initiative, fall are under the effects of the Bane Jutsu cast at D-Rank. This effect can be ended as bane normally could vis dispelling effects.

traits.name: Neglectful of Self
traits.description: The Waterfall village enforces an idea of self preservation second, village success first. When a hostile creature would show itself to be a threat to the Land of Hills or the Waterfall Village, you begin to express a neglectful form of fighting to bring down your enemy for the pride of your country, you gain the followings; -2 Penalty to AC and all saving throws, but gain a +5 Bonus to all ability checks and damage rolls.

traits.name: Heroes Thirst
traits.description: You take a sip from a small vial of heroes water. This water magnifies its abilities to that of unprecedented figures. It gains a +2 bonus to All ability scores for the next minute, but in exchange for this power, it automatically, reduces its current and maximum hit points by an amount equal to 25% of its maximum hit points. This hit point reduction ignores health gates if you are a Solo.

traits.name: Hero Water
traits.description: You take a large gulp from a moderate jug of heroes water. This water magnifies its abilities to that of unprecedented figures. You gain a +4 bonus to All ability scores for the next minute, but in exchange for this power, you automatically, reduce your current and maximum hit points by an amount equal to 50% of your maximum hit points. This hit point reduction ignores health gates if you are a Solo.

traits.name: Rainy Days
traits.description: While engaged in combat with a creature whom the Land of Pipes or the Rain Village considers a hostile entity, you begin to experience flash backs of the death and desolation your village/country has experienced and you vow to NEVER allow that to happen again. When rolling initiative, select one hostile creature. That creature becomes Rain marked. You will exclusively target and attack a Rain marked creature until they are dead. Additionally, while in the Land of Pipes, you cannot lose concentration on jutsu you cast as a result of damage on being incapacitated.

traits.name: Short Fuse, Long Memory
traits.description: Hostile Creatures who would deal damage to you become Rain Marked. While Rain marked, for the next 12 months, you will remember and hunt for a marked creature. They suffer a -5 penalty to stealth and Deception checks vs you or your allies within 120 feet of you. Your sole purpose in life becomes the ending of their lives.

traits.name: Faithful
traits.description: You are faithful to the teachings of the Rain Temple, its leader, or its captain. Those embued with such faith cannot have their faith challenged. When they would make a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution saving throw they can choose to succeed each save, once per encounter.

traits.name: Hazardous Atmosphere
traits.description: You wear a rebreather that grants you immunity to effects from gasses, vapors or smoke. Additionally, you passively release a vile and potent poisonous mist. All hostil creatures who begin their turns within 10ft of you, must make a Constitution saving throw vs. [5+Level+Prof], gaining 2 ranks of envenomed on a failed save for the next minute.

traits.name: War Born Prejudice
traits.description: You have lived through multiple invasions of your country as a child and dismisses the idea of hostile threats to your home any longer. When a hostile creature would attempt to make a saving throw to resist a Jutsu you casts, you can empower the jutsu cast to become a War Born Jutsu. A jutsu enhanced in this way, is upcasted twice, at no cost. Additionally, the save DC to resist is increased by +2. This empowerment can only be used twice per encounter.

traits.name: Snowy Spring
traits.description: While engaged in combat with a creature whom the land of Snow/Springs or the Snow village considers a hostile entity, you release a surge of cold chakra. All hostile creatures who begin within 30 feet of you must succeed a Constitution saving throw vs. your Ninjutsu Save DC. On a failed save, the creature gains 1 rank of Chilled for the next minute.

traits.name: Snow Tech
traits.description: You have a Kunai Launcher that fires Kunai and Shuriken at lethal speeds. In place of one of this creatures attacks, it can make a 'Kunai Barrage' attack, using your Taijutsu attack bonus, dealing a number of d6s equal to half your level in piercing or slashing damage. Alternatively, you can set the weapon to burst fire as an Action, releasing a cluster of weapons in a cone. All creatures in a 30 foot cone originating from you must succeed a Dexterity saving throw vs. your Taijutsu Save DC, taking a number of d4s equal to half your level in piercing or slashing damage or half as much on a successful save.

traits.name: Land of Spring
traits.description: While within the land of Snow/Spring, at the beginning of each of this adversaries turns, roll 1d8. On a result of 5~8, this adversary automatically removes 1 rank of any condition, regardless of the jutsu rank that applied it.

traits.name: Chakra Armour
traits.description: You have a micro chakra engine attached to your person. This engine generates a powerful barrier protecting you. This barrier has a number of hit points equal to [Level x 10]. It intercepts all damage this adversary would take and is resistant to all Damage types, except psychic, and is immune to chakra damage. trait can be temporarily deactivated if this adversary is targeted by a special effect such as B-Rank Chakra dispel or Uzumaki Break. You can change the effect or jutsu needed to one your party has such as a specific condition, Action or damage type. This trait is deactivated until the end of this adversaries next turn.

traits.name: Snow Release
traits.description: This adversary can cast all Yuki clan Hijutsu, as if its cost was treated as 1 rank lower.
traits.categories: Attack, Defence, Control, Mobility, Utility, Buff

traits.name: Bonds of the Blade
traits.description: While engaged in combat with a creature whom the land of Iron considers a hostile entity, you manifest a blade of chakra with the intent to protect your own, and your countries honor. This blade counts as a Martial Weapon, that deals 2d8 + Strength Modifier + Dexterity Modifier Slashing damage. Has the Critical, Deadly, and Versatile(2d10) weapon properties. Additionally, this weapon can be used for Bukijutsu with Slashing or Piercing Melee requirements.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: This adversary has advantage on saving throws against gaining the fear condition. Additionally, this adversary gains advantage on attacks against targets with ranks of fear.

traits.name: Samurai Armor Mastery
traits.description: This Adversary has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, but all damage they would take is reduced by 5, excluding chakra and psychic damage.

traits.name: Three Wolves Fang
traits.description: When this adversary would roll initiative, while it has no allied creatures in the same initiative count, it realizes its attacks must become more lethal, and far more precise, in order to survive. Hostile creatures whom this creature inflicts the bleeding condition onto, are sliced or pierced at their joints. While a hostile creature is bleeding, they suffer a -1 penalty to their AC, up to a maximum of -5.

traits.name: Absolute Inscription
traits.description: When this adversary would become Bloodied (50% Hp), they entered an awakened state. Their weapons become flush with a violent surge of chakra, their speed multiplies, and their agility doubles. For the remainder of combat, this adversaries maximum hit points are reduced by 50%, all weapon damage is doubled, movement speed is doubled, and they gain one additional reaction per round. This adversary can only enter this awakened state once per combat.

traits.name: Floating Majesty
traits.description: While engaged in combat with a creature whom the Land of the Sky, or the Sky Village considers a hostile entity, this adversary gain an additional action, which it can take the attack action, to make exclusively ranged weapon attacks.

traits.name: Sky Tech
traits.description: This adversary has access to sky tech, which constitutes mechanical wings with jet thrusters powered by the users chakra. This adversary gains a 60ft fly speed.

traits.name: Graceful Charity
traits.description: This adversaery gains immunity to the Dazed and incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Winged Dominance.
traits.description: When this adversary would cast a Jutsu with the wind release keyword, they gain a bonus +30 fly speed until the beginning of their next turn.

traits.name: Zero-Tails
traits.description: This adversary is partially inhabited by the sealed, and corrupted spirit of the Zero-Tails. This adversary can, as a bonus action, manifest a number of spectral arms to assist it in performing jutsu, making attacks or defending it. If this adversary manifest spectral arms in this way, at the end of each hostile creatures turn, the spectral arms perform on of the following; Unarmed melee attack with a 15ft range; +[Level + Half Prof] to hit,  dealing [Level/4]d8 bludgeoning damage, Cast a Jutsu this adversary knows of C-Rank or lower, Make a grapple attempt with a range of 15ftc, treating its Athletics bonus as a +[Level+prof]. Alternatively, as a reaction the arms can wrap around this adversaries body granting it [Prof]d10 temporary hit points until the end of the current turn.

traits.name: Sacrifices must be Made
traits.description: This adversary must sacrifice another humanoid creature once every 7 Days. If they do not they cannot gain the benefit of this trait. When a sacrifice is made for this traits maintenance this adversary has 7 Charges. They expend a charge whenever they would fall to 0 hit points. After 1 hour, they raise from the dead with full health and Chakra.

traits.name: You scream, I scream
traits.description: This adversary marks a creature when initiative is rolled. The marked creature is considered Marked for Pain. A creature marked in this way, whom this adversary deals at least 10% of its Hit points to with Slashing or Piercing damage, has the mark take effect for the next minute. While the mark is in effect, the marked creature takes half of all damage this adversary takes. The damage type is necrotic and cannot be reacted to, reduced, or resisted.

traits.name: My Pain, is your Pain
traits.description: This adversary marks a creature when initiative is rolled. The marked creature is considered Marked for Pain. A creature marked in this way, whom this adversary deals at least 10% of its Hit points to with Slashing or Piercing damage, has the mark take effect for the next minute. While the mark is in effect, the marked creatures maximum hit points is reduced by half of all damage this adversary takes.

traits.name: Immortal Love
traits.description: While this Adversary has a Creature Marked for Pain, it cannot be reduced below 1 Hit point.

traits.name: For My Lord
traits.description: This adversary can choose to target itself for attacks, treating the hit as if it were a critical hit, and always dealing maximum damage.

traits.name: Silent Revenge
traits.description: While engaged in combat with a creature whom the Land of the Empty, or the Silent Village considers a hostile entity, this adversary gains a +[Level] bonus to stealth checks. Additionally, This adversary can take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide actions as a bonus action.

traits.name: Move in Silence
traits.description: This Adversary makes no sound while moving, running or dashing. Additionally, they do not immediately reveal themselves, instead they immediately remake their Dexterity (Stealth) check vs the target creatures Wisdom (Perception) check.

traits.name: Sleeper Cell
traits.description: This Adversary can vanish into a crowd, being able to blend in with basically any group, organization or collection of people. Regardless of their location they always have a history in the location with most inhabitants recognizing them as their friend, neighbor, lover etc. When they would make a Performance or Deception check to pretend to be apart of a community, they gain a +20 bonus to the check.

traits.name: Strength in Numbers
traits.description: This adversary gains a +1 Bonus to their Attack, Damage, Saving throws, and AC, for every allied creature adjacent to them.

traits.name: Primal Serum
traits.description: As an Action this adversary can consume a special serum. When they do, they take on beatial qualities, transforming into a werewolves. This adversary gains a +2 bonus to their Strength, Dexterity and Constitution scores. They also gains Feral Claws. These claws replace their unarmed attacks, dealing 1d8+[Str+Dex] Slashing damage, and a Bite attack that deals 2d4+[Str+Dex], which they can use in place of one of their claw attacks.

traits.name: Akatsuki Faithful
traits.description: While engaged in combat with a creature whom the Akatsuki considers a hostile entity or target, this adversary Selects two ability scores. This adversary cannot make the chosen attack rolls, saving throws or ability checks at disadvantage.

traits.name: Servant of God & His Angel
traits.description: This adversary has learned from God and his Angel how to exert their will on their enemies. As an action, all hostile creatures within 90 feet of this adversary must make a Strength saving throw vs  Ninjutsu save DC. On a failed save, affected creatures are thrown to the ground taking [Half Level]d10 bludgeoning damage and being prone. A creature prone in this way cannot stand or move, or make handseals. They can as an action remake this saving throw to end this effect on them. This trait can be used twice per combat

traits.name: Servant of The Puppet and The Artist
traits.description: This adversary has learned from The Puppet and the Artist how to create lasting beauty, or an instant Art. As an action this adversary can select two creatures up to 60 feet away to infect.  Select creatures must make a Constitution saving throw vs Ninjutsu Save DC. On a failed save, the targets become physically controlled by this adversary, unable to act on its turn. It can still see and speak, but cannot take actions or react on its own. As a bonus action on this adversaries turn, they can command the controlled creature as if they were a puppet to make attacks, cast jutsu or interpose an attack for them, taking damage in their place. Alternatively, as an action, the controlled creature can be primed to explode, suddenly exploding due to clusters of paper bombs, taking [Level]d6 fire damage and all creatures within 10 feet of the creature must make a Dexterity saving throw taking half damage on a success.

traits.name: Servant of the Undying
traits.description: This adversary has learned to survive through death from the Undying. The first two times this creature would fall to 0 hit points, they raise from the dead with 25% of their maximum hit points, at the beginning of their following turn.

traits.name: Servant of  the Traitors
traits.description: This adversary has learned to betray, from the traitors. When this adversary would take a reaction, they also are able to choose to cast a jutsu with the casting time of a reaction that deals damage, in addition to whatever reaction they originally took.

traits.name: Kara Faithful
traits.description:
While engaged in combat with a creature whom Kara considers a hostile entity or target, this adversary gains the ability to absorb chakra in a limited fashion. As a Reaction to it taking damage or making a saving throw against a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu cast, it can absorb the jutsu cast, storing it for later use. This adversary can absorb jutsu in this way once before it has to Recharge. (Recharge 5-6).

As an action, this adversary can recast the absorbed jutsu using its Ninjutsu attack bonus/Save DC as its casting statistics if needed.

traits.name: Kara Inner
traits.description: This Adversary has been heavily modified by Kara's Primary Scientist. They are more machine than man. Select any two Role traits that isn't from their current Role. If the trait chosen has any costs double the chosen costs. (You may have to switch their current Role to make this section. But be sure to switch their role back.)
traits.categories: Attack, Defence, Control, Mobility, Utility, Buff

traits.name: Kara Outter
traits.description: This Adversary has been minorly modified by Kara's Primary Scientist. They are boosted by the small enhancements provided. Select any two Clan Traits that isn't from their current clan. If the trait chosen has any costs double the chosen costs. (You may have to switch their current Clan to make this section. But be sure to switch their Clan back.)
traits.categories: Attack, Defence, Control, Mobility, Utility, Buff

traits.name: Kara Tech
traits.description: This Adversaries body has been infused with the DNA of an Otsutsuki. You gain one Otsutsuki clan traits and 1 jutsu of any rank, regardless of any other limitations.
traits.categories: Attack, Defence, Control, Mobility, Utility, Buff

traits.name: Failed Karma
traits.description: This adversary was born for one reason, and one reason alone. To become the host Body of the Kara Leader. The first time they would be reduced to 0 hit points, their hit points are restored back to 75%, and they gain the the Karmic Release, Stage 1, from the Karma Class Mod.

traits.name: Our Lord
traits.description: While engaged in combat with a creature whom this creatures cult considers a hostile entity or target, this adversary gains the benefits of the Dancing Blades Genjutsu always regaining 1d4 Illusory Weapons at the beginning of each of its turns. This trait can be temporarily deactivated if this adversary is targeted by a special effect such as C-Rank Chakra dispel or Uzumaki Break. You can change the effect or jutsu needed to one your party has such as a specific condition, Action or damage type. The aura is deactivated until the end of this adversaries next turn.

traits.name: Their Machinations
traits.description: While engaged in combat with a creature whom this creatures cult considers a hostile entity or target, this adversary gains the benefits of the Song of Pain Genjutsu without needing to spend a Bonus action to maintain it, they instead must spend chakra each turn equal to twice its normal costs to maintain its effects, otherwise it immediately ends. This trait can be temporarily deactivated if this adversary is targeted by a special effect such as B-Rank Chakra dispel or Uzumaki Break.
